tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo so gsum yan gyi nyams dbyangs kyi skor sogs thor bu 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bzhugs/ /legs par bshad pa yid kyi gdung sel zhes bya ba bzhugs/127 'dir smras pa/ rnal 'byor ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis dpal sa skya'i bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bu na rang nyid gcig pur gong ma'i gsung rab glegs bam mang po la blta zhing yid skyo seng nge gnas pa'i tshe/ de'i nye skor du phug ron zhig byung nas 'di skad ces zer ro/ /khyed gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i blo gros gsal bas gzhon nu nyid nas chos la dad/ bla ma bzang po dang mjal/ rje btsun gong ma'i rnam thar skyong bar 'dod pas byed rgyu chos las med pa zhig 'dug pa 'di ngo mtshar che ste/ da dus dma' bas bstan pa mar 'grib la thug pas/ bstan pa gsal bar nus pa'i bshes gnyen rnams las blun po dag kun gyi gces par 'dzin/ chos rgyal rnams nyams sdig rgyal rnams dar/ /mdor na don gyi chos bzhin byed pa'i gang zag rnams la/ gong nas skyong mkhan med/ 'og nas 'debs mkhan med/ mnyam pos chags sdang phrag dog gi sgo nas gnod ci 'khyol byed pa sogs/ /deng sang gi chos mdzad rnams 'o brgyal chen po rang gda' bas/ khyed rang kyang spyi sgos kyi bstan pa bsam mi 'grub pa'i don bsgrub pa'i 'o brgyal 'di 'dra mdzad pa las/ deng sang gi phal pa rnams dang / chos mdzad du khas 'che ba dag gi byed lugs 'di bzhin mdzad na legs pa ma yin nam/ zhes pa'i lan du kho bos 'di skad smras so/ /khyod phug ron gyi smras pa'i gtam gyi don/ /'ga' bden mod kyi kha cig bden rgyu med/ /dus snyigs ma yi rtags kun 'dug mod kyang / /nga spyi sgos kyi bstan pa bsam pa yi/

/don mi 'grub pa 'dra yang 'grub nges te/ /khong dkon mchog thugs rje'i mi bslu'i phyir/ /dus deng sang gi mi rnams phal che ba/ /las byed rgyu mi dge bcu por 'dug /khong chos mdzad tsho ji ltar mdzad kyin 'dug /ces smras pas/ kho na re/ deng sang chos mdzad thos bsam byed lo rnams gzhung sna re mi shes kyang ngo tsha med kyi rab 'byams pa'i ming re thogs pa byed/ yon tan dga' rab yod pa rnams kyang khong rang tsho rigs mthun gyi nang bstod mi byed par gcig gi gong du gcig shor dogs bsam nas smad gang thub mdzad/ khong bla ma phal cher yang / thog mar thos pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa/ bar du bla ma mkhas pa bsten pa/ tha mar rang nyid nyams su len pa sogs gang yang med par/ dbang chog tshig rkyang re tsam smra rgyu yod pa sogs la rang gzhan kun la phan par rlom zhing de ltar du khas len dang bcas/ mkhas pa dag khrel ba'i rgyu kho na byed cing / slob ma snod dang ldan mi ldan yang nor rdzas bzang ngan la rag las kyi 'dug lags/ bsgrub chen pa rnams kyang lto gos gtam gsum la gyong bskur ba'i sgrub pa mi mdzad par/ lto gos gtam gsum gyi ched du nyi ma mi 'khyol zhing sdug bsran bskyed pa de ri la bzhugs pas bzhugs pa rjes med ka mang bar 'dug cing / mdor na deng sang gi chos pa phal mo che 'phral spyod chos lugs ltar snang yang kun slong dug gsum ka shas che ba 'dug lags na'ang / deng sang ni de tsho ka kha yang drag nor yang phyug gnyen 'khor yang mang ba sogs mdor na mthun rkyen shin tu 'dzoms shing / don gyi chos bzhin byed pa rnams de las ldog te gda' bas/ gong zhus ltar khyed rang yang deng sang gi skye bo rnams kyis byed lugs bzhin mdzad na mthun rkyen 'dzoms par 'gyur bas thugs bde ba 'ong ba 'dra lags/ zer ba'i lan du 'di skad ces smras so/ /dus deng sang gi chos pa phal che ba'i/ las byed lugs de ltar 'dug mod kyi/

mi kho bo la mthun rkyen med pa 'di/ las chos mthun rang byas pa rkyang pas min/ /khong gong bzhugs la khur cha che bar byas/ /rang mnyam po la thabs mkhas du mas 'grogs/ /kho zhan pa la'ang mnyam 'grogs byas pa sogs/ /don gzhan sems dang 'gal dogs byas pas lan/ /tshul de min byas na 'di min zhig /mi thams cad la yongs ba kho bo la/ /don mi 'byung rgyu med mod 'on kyang ni/ /tshul de ltar du byas pa rang gzhan la/ /dus 'phral phugs su legs par go ba yin/ /zhes smras pas/ kho na re/ re chen po zhig yod kyang yod de rjes su yi rang / khyed rang gzhan dang mi 'dra bas min pa/ gzhan chos don gyi mdzad pa phal cher yang mthun rkyen 'dzoms zhing rkyen ngan med tshe/ /thos bsam sgom pas kun thugs rgyud 'byor gyi 'dug kyang / de las ldog tshe gang yang mi dran pa kho na mang yang / khyed la ni mthun rkyen gang ma 'dzoms kyang de tsam gyi khyad par mi 'dug pa 'di lhag par ngo mtshar che/ zer ba'i lan du 'di skad smras so/ /nga shes rgyud 'phags nor gyis phyug pas/ rdzas zang zing dag byung yang smon rgyu med/ /nga rang sems dang bla ma dam gsum/ /don dbyer med kyi grogs la 'bral rgyu med/ /gzhan sems kyi grogs de mdza' yang 'bral/ /rgyu de ba na gnyen 'khor la smon rgyu med/ /lar grogs med kyi rtog 'gyu 'phel ba'i phyir/ /yid skyo ba la bzod glags mi gda' ste/ /gang ltar kyang rung phyogs re las gzhan pa'i/ yid bsam rgyu med de 'dra bya ma myong / zhes smras pas/ yang kho na re/ khyed kyi mdzad tshul gang nas bsam yang thugs la spangs rtogs kyi yon tan khyad par can zhig yod nges su 'dug pas de bdag la gsungs pa zhu/ zer ba'i lan du 'di skad smras so/ /nga sngon bsags kyi las 'phro bzang ba'i mthus/ /rten 'di dal 'byor gyi mi lus mchog 'di thob/ /lo gzhon nu nas don gnyer chos las med/ /rje grub thob kyi drin las rab tu byung /

/de'i rjes nyid du chos rje mus chen gyis/ /gsung bdud rtsis bdag blo'i bum pa bkang / /rgyu de bas na rang gzhan bstan gsum la/ /cher phan 'dod kyi bsam pa bzang po de/ /rkyen bzhi tsam zhig byung kyang ldog ma myong / /mi kho bo la yon tan 'di kho na/ /gzhan sna gcig kyang med do 'on kyang ni/ /dus deng sang gi bstan 'dzin gzhan rnams las/ /nged khyad par 'phags pa mthun snang grub/ /ha ha zhes smras pas/ kho na re/ yon tan sba ba dam pa'am/ mkhas pa'i lugs su gda' bas slar zhu mi spobs/ gang ltar yang bdag gi da res kyi lus rten 'di la dam pa'i chos byed skal ba mi 'dug pas skye ba phyi ma la khyed kyis rjes su bzung bar zhu/ zer ba'i lan du 'di skad ces smras so/ /rje mkhyen brtse nus pa kun ldan pa'i/ /pha sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan thugs rje yis/ /mi bdag gi don gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /grangs mtha' med 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /kun kho bos gdul byar 'gyur bar shog /ces smras pas kho rab tu dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur 'ga' re ston zhing / bdag yid mgu/ yid mgu zer zhing 'phur song ngo / /zhes pa 'di ni skyes thob blo gros rab tu gsal ba'i sa bon/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi thugs rje dang gsung gi bdud rtsi'i drod cher gyis bskyangs pa la brten nas rnam dpyod kyi 'bras bu che cher rgyas pa sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o/ /nyams dbyangs mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/128 /na mo gu ru puṇ+ya in+d+ra ye/ rje 'brel tshad don ldan sa skya pa'i/ /gdung dri ma med pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /las dag pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i/ /rje grub chen puṇ+ya in+d+ra de/ /mi kho bo'i spyi gtsug rgyan du mdzes/ /dus rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos bzung nas kyang /

/bdag tshe 'di'am 'chi kha'am bar do ru/ /don 'bras bu smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / /yid gtod sa gzhan na mi gda' bas/ /pha bla ma dkon mchog gsum po mkhyen/ /sems kho thag chod do dkon mchog tshogs/ bdag gi dus min 'chi las skyabs du gsol/ /dus ngan pa deng sang snyigs ma'i dus/ /mi nyon mongs rags pa'i spyod ngan gyis/ /spyir bstan pa'i sgron me mnal la thug /sgos 'khrul med rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan dri med rgyun bzang chad la nye/ /tshul 'di 'dra bsam gyin mchi ma dku/ /dus deng sang dbus gtsang sde dpon rnams/ /khong rgyal brgyud dri med 'bangs su 'bebs/ /kho 'bangs 'os rnams kyis rgyal sa 'dzin/ /don chos skyod rgyal po'i dar rgyas nyams/ /kho sdig spyod rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas/ /tshul 'di yang bsam zhing skyo ba skyes/ /lar dus ngan snyigs ma 'di 'dra la/ /blo bsam mno btang gyin ngal ba'i rgyu/ /da de bas spros pa'i 'phro bcad de/ /tshul 'di bzhin rgyud la sbyor bar rigs/ /spyir mi lus thob pa dkon mod kyang / /sgos chos mjal rab byung nyin skar tsam/ /cher dkon pa'i don gnyis ldan dus 'dir/ /dus gtan du bde 'dod bsam pa yis/ /don dgos med tshe 'dir bya ba rnams /sems chags zhen spangs te rgyab tu bskyur/ /tshul 'di bzhin lag tu len par rigs/ /rje bla ma grub thob 'bad nas tshol/ /de mnyes byed thabs la rtsol ba bskyed/ /sems skye med rtogs pa'i gdams pa zhus/ /skyon yon tan len shes rgyud la sbyor/ /rgyud yon tan 'ga' dang ma ldan bar/ /rje bla ma'i drung nas 'bad nas bsgom/ /yid skyid shos spangs te snying rus bskyed/ /rang rtogs pa'i gdengs 'ga' thob rjes su/ /gnas nges med dben gnas bsten pa gces/ /gos gtum mo'i gos la 'chol ba gces/ /zas dka' thub rlung zas bsten pa gces/

/don 'jig rten lto gos snyan grags la/ /sems re 'dod rtsad nas gcod pa gces/ /rang myur du 'bras bu thob 'dod pa'i/ /sems snying rus bsgom bsran bskyed pa gces/ /don 'di bzhin lag tu len nus na/ /sems skye ba med pa'i don rtogs 'gyur/ /don skye med rtogs na 'chi med thob/ /gdeng de dang mi ldan skye bo rnams/ /cher rab 'jigs 'ching ba kun la spongs/ /lo rgan gzhon gang gi thub rgyu med/ /nad zug rngus mnar zhing 'chi bar shes/ /de shes kyang bzlog thabs spu tsam med/ /yul rang yul yin zhes sdod dbang med/ /nor rang nor yin zhes 'khyer dbang med/ /gnyen mdza' bshes yin zhes 'grogs dbang med/ /rang gcig pur dbang med 'gro dgos pa'i/ /dus ngan pa de la ma thug gong / /don 'chi med rtogs pa'i thabs bzang la/ /blo le lor ma sdod rtsol ba bskyed/ /chos sha ma rang zhig byed mod kyang / /long yod snyam slod las ma 'dug cig /yang de tsam snying rus mi lcogs na/ /spyir don gnyis ldan pa mngon 'gyur mod/ /sgos rab tu byung zhing khrims la gnas/ /bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos thos bsam bya/ /rje bla ma bsten la gdams ngag zhus/ /chos 'chad rtsod rtsom sogs rnam dkar la/ /dus rnam pa kun du 'bad 'bungs bskyed/ /rang rgyun du zab mo'i nyams len la/ /sems g.yel med 'bad de brtson par rigs/ /don bsdu ba'i tshig la 'di ltar te/ /rje kun mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob phyir/ /rang tshe 'dis snang ba ma nub bar/ /las rnam dkar kho nas 'da' ba dang / /rang 'chi khar bla ma'i thugs kha ru/ /sems 'gro nges 'pho ba'i gdams pa zhig /yid le lor ma gtong 'bad nas sbyongs/ /rang 'chi khar 'pho ba theb nges mdzod/ /tshul 'di bzhin lag tu len nus na/ /don 'chi khar grub mtha' snyogs par nges/ /rab tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thong nas/ /chos bsgrub pas grub pa thob pa'am/ /tshul 'di gnyis gang rung lag lon na/

/rten dal 'byor stong log spangs pa yin/ /chos mjal bas mjal go chod pa yin/ /mi bdag kyang de bzhin nyams len pas/ /rje bslu med rnams kyi thugs rje yin/ /bdag tshe yi bar chad kun zhi nas/ /don mtha' ru 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bu dad ldan rnams kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /de snying gtam yin no rgyud la sbyor/ /tshul 'di bzhin tshigs su bcad pa 'di/ /cher rab dga'i sar bzhugs puṇ+ya mtshan/ /rje gang der snying nas dad thob pa/ /dpal sa skya pa yi rigs skyes shing / /yongs 'gro mgon zas gtsang sras po yi/ /bstan dri ma med pa'i sgor zhugs pa/ /ming ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /'gro yongs la grags pa bdag gis sbyar/ /tshul 'di ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /don rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa 'grol ba'i yan lag bzhugs/129 na mo gu ru sa ma ye/ sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /puṇ+ya in+d+ra mched dang mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes su yongs grags pa'i/ 'gran gyi do med gsum la snying nas 'dud/ /bdag cag deng nas sems nyid ma rtogs bar/ /rgyun du dam pa gsum gyis rjes bzung nas/ /don gnyis 'grub pa 'bad med lhun grub shog /kun spangs kun ldan myur du thob gyur cig /kye ma 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams/ /rang gis rang bcings snying re rje/ /de don cung zad 'chad pa la/ /dpe don gnyis las dang po ni/ /rin chen gser gyi dngos po zhig /mi gtsang rdzas kyi gos gyur te/ /gser du kun gyis shes dka' ba/ /dpe yin don ni rang gi sems/ /gdod nas dri ma dang bral yang / /bag chags ngan pas gos par gsungs/ /de phyir blo gros ldan pa'i mis/ mi gtsang rdzas kyi gos pa'i gser/ /brtags pas phyi nas ngo shes ltar/ /dad brtson ldan pas rab 'bad na/ /bag chags kun sel the tshom med/

/des na gtan du bde 'dod rnams/ /rang gi rang sdug ma bzo bar/ /gcig shes kun grol zab lam la/ /brtson par mdzod cig dad ldan tsho/ /da ni rang la gros shig gleng / /'khrul zhig bla ma mchog rnams kyis/ /snang srid sems su ngo sprod cing / /de yang skye 'gag gnas gsum dang / /bral bas de don sgoms shig gsungs/ /gzhan yang ma dag snod bcud kun/ /rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin du/ /mnyam rjes kun du mos pa dang / /snang stong zung 'jug 'ba' zhig blos/ /rgyun chad med par 'da' bar gces/ /de skad gsungs phyir bdag gis kyang / /dben par bsgom pas blo bgyis pa'i/ /ma dag rnam rtog je nyung du/ /'gro dgos yin mod bdag la ni/ /sngon sbyangs chung pa'i ma dag pa'i/ /rnam rtog je 'phel je 'phel song / /bdag 'dra'i blun po'i 'khrul tshab la/ /'dren mchog rnams kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ /skye med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rtsa ba ni/ /bdag 'dzin nyid yin gzhan las min/ /ci phyir zhe na rang sems 'di'i/ /'khrul snang kun la bden bzung bas/ /grangs med lus dang sdug bsngal dag /blangs shing myong nas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /yin zhes gong ma'i gsung las shes /de bas bdag ni da phyin chad/ /sems la mchog 'bring tha ma dang / /bzang ngan legs nyes bde sdug sogs/ /bag chags 'khrul snang ci shar rung / /cung zad bden 'dzin 'byung srid kyang / /bag med par ni 'dzin ri kan/ /gang shar bla med theg pa la/ /brten nas rnam kun mchog ldan gyis/ /sa nas thob med 'bras bu de/ /'gro drug srid las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /myur du 'grub par bdag re 'o/ /re ba gting nas zad gyur na/ /de bas lhag pa'i 'bras bu zhig /logs na med snyam kho bo sems/ /'di lta'i gdams pa zab mo ni/ /'khon rigs shākya'i btsun pa'i tshul/ /ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i 'khrul tshab can/

/'ga' la phan phyir dben pa'i gnas/ /gling dga' bde ba can du bris/ /'di bris bsod nams de yi mthus/ /bdag cag dus 'dir lo brgya'i bar/ /'tsho ba bslu med dkon mchog gi /byin gyis brlabs nas bsam pa kun/ /'bad med mtha' ru 'khyol gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //zhal gdams zin bris bdud rtsis thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/130 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen che/ /mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /gsung gi bum bzang las 'ongs pa'i/ /man ngag bdud rtsi 'dir spel lo/ /de la 'dir rang shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bcu phrag gnyis su gsum gyi ma lon pa chu mo glang gi lo/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs la grags pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag 'brel tshad don dang ldan nges pa'i yongs su 'dzin pa chen po de nyid kyi zhabs drung du slebs te/ skyes bu'i gtsug rgyan dam pa de nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi mtha' dag ngoms med du 'thung zhing zab gnad la bcud len bgyid pa'i skabs shig rang gi sems kyi 'char sgo 'ga' rje'i zhabs drung du phul bas/ de lan du zhal gdams kyi yi ge zhig gnang byung ba la bltas pas man ngag zab mo kun gyi yangs rtse'i bcud bsdus su nges pa'i shes pa gting thag pa nas 'drongs te brjed pas 'jigs nas gnang 'phral yi ger btab pa ni 'di ltar ste/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyi drung du zhu ba/ mnyam rjes gnyis ka la sems hon ne yongs ba de sems gnas pa'i 'bud tsam yin/ de la rig pa la ngar cung zad ston/ bsgom pa'ang gdod de sems kyi rang mdangs a rnyed lta/ bltas pas ston gyi nam mkha' dwangs pa la bltas pa bzhin rig stong rjen ne ye re ba/ mar me rlung gi ma bskyod pa lta bu rang gsal lhag ge ba/

rang mdangs yal le ba/ sems kyi ngo bo 'di rang yin par 'dug snyam pa tsam/ yul gyi steng du btang kyang mi 'gro ba zhig byung na/ sems la tho cung zad thong ba'i rtags lags/ lar sems hon ne ba de la kyai rdor dang mgon po ltar na spyan dbus ma nas gsal 'debs bde mchog ltar na zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nas sems bzung nas gsal ba'i rgyas 'debs/ skyon yon gang du yang mi 'dzin pa gdam ngag lags/ dkon mchog gsum la mos gus byed pa shin tu gal che lags zhes rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun bud+dha'i mtshan can gyi zhal gyis gdams pa'i zin bris bdud rtsis thigs pa zhes bya ba 'di ni 'dren mchog de nyid kyi thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis bu gcig pa ltar 'tsho ba shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong a nan+da'i ming can gyis gling dga' bde ba can du bris pa las slar yang rje bla ma'i gsung la bsnon 'phri spang pa'i mgo mjug gi tshig rnams la bsnan kha cung zad dang bcas dpal sa skya'i bde mchog pho brang du bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rjes spyod nyams len gong 'phel gyi yi ge zhes bya ba bzhugs/131 mtshan thos par dka' ba sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur ba mtshon don/ /baiḍūr sa gzhi yi dbus su/ /'gro la dgos 'dod dag 'byung don/ /rin chen khri chen gyi steng du/ /tshul ston nyes pa yi ma gos/ /mtshon don pad+ma yi sdong po/ /de sting dmigs med kyi shes rab/ /rang bzhin nyi ma yi dkyil 'khor/ /rab rgyas dmigs med kyi snying rje'i/ /ngo bo zla ba yi gdan steng / /rang sems bla ma dang dbyer med/ /rnam pa rin chen gyi 'byung ldan/ /sku mdog btso ma yi mdog can /skyil krung mchog sbyin dang mnyam bzhag /rin chen rgyan cha yi phyug pa/ /mtshan bzang so gnyis dang dpe byad/ brgyad cu thams cad kyi brgyan pa/ /'gro la dgos 'dod dag stsol zhing / /'od zer bye ba yi tshogs 'gyed/

/gsal stong ngo bo yi sku de'i/ /nga rgyal dus kun du gsal zhing / /gang mthong bla ma yi sku ste/ /ci thos bla ma yi gsung mchog /gang bsam bla ma yi thugs yin/ /kun kyang bde stong du gsal le/ rig stong brjod med du sing nge / 'di 'dra'i nyams kyi rang dga' ba/ mtshan ldan bla ma yi drin yin/ /rje btsun mus chen gyi drin yin/ /bud+dha dh+wa dza yi drin yin/ bka' drin mtshungs pa med gang der/ /rgyun chad med pa ru gsol 'debs/ /byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ 'bral med thugs rje yi zungs shig /ces pa 'di rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung bas theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor par gyur pa sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis rjes spyod kyi nyams len la dran 'dun drag po bskyed de bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //gsung ngag lam 'bras la thos bsam byed dus kyi rmi lam yi ger bris pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/132 na mo bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ 'dir smras pa/ me 'brug lo rgyal gyi zla ba yis/ /tshes gsum gyi tho rang rmi lam du/ pha sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan khong byon nas/ /bu khyod kyi gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi/ /dpe ji tsam song zhes bka' stsal thos/ /de'i lan du bdag gis 'di ltar zhus/ /bdag bya ba mang bas sngar yan la/ /stobs chen po ma song zhus pa'i lan/ /sngar song ba rnams la bsgrags skyong mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa thos pas gnyid sad pas/ sems dga' spro dpag med thob par gyur/ gzugs mthong tshad mtshan ldan bla ma'i sku/ /sgra thos tshad mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung / /sems rtog 'gyu thams cad bla ma'i thugs/ /de kun bde stong rol pa che/ /chos de nyid ngag dbang kun bsod ngas/ /dus rgyun gyi nyams len byed lugs yin/ /zhes pa 'di sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis gsung ngag lam 'bras la thos bsam byed dus zhag 'ga' 'gyang pa'i skabs kyi rmi lam brjed pas 'jigs te bris pa legs/

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs ngan pa'i spyod pa la khrel ba'i gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs/133 'dir smras par bya ba 'di lta ste/ dus deng sang skabs kyi mi phal cher/ /thabs ji tsam zhig byas kyang 'grogs par dka'/ /tshig lan gcig tsam rtsub la khro gnyer g.yo/ /don cung zad cig la 'khon du 'dzin/ /rdzas yungs 'bru tsam zhig la zhib rtsis gtong / /sems dung pa yid 'phro la 'gyur ldog mang / /zhen phyi thag tu mi bsrings skyon mtshang 'bru/ /mi gzhan dag la gnod pa'i bya ba rnams/ /rang ngal kyang rung sna tshogs thabs kyi bsgrub/ /blo gzur gnas kyi blang dor mi phyed par/ /rang blun po rnams lhan cig tu gnas nas/ /gzhan dam pa la skyon brjod ngag 'don gyis/ /lo zla ba dang zhag kun de kas 'da'/ /rang gang dang mthun de la gnod pa bskyel/ /rgyud mdo rgyud kyi phyug pa rnams bor nas/ /nor zang zing dang ldan rnams rgyun du mchod/ /blo gzur gnas dag mkhas par bkur ba la/ /kho blun po rnams mgrin gcig tu byas nas/ 'di mi 'os zhes smras pa 'di ngo mtshar/ /tshul 'di 'dra ka byas pa'i rjes nyid la/ /gzhan stobs ldan gyi skyes bu 'ga' 'brangs pas/ /sngar yan chad kyang bstan pa nyams pa'i rgyu/ /'di kho na rang yin par bdag gis rtogs/ /nga ltos med kyi rnal 'byor blo ldan ngang / /blo ri bong gi cal rgyugs mi bya bar/ /rje mtshan ldan rnams srog ltar gces par 'dzin/ /khong bshes gnyen dag bu ltar brtse bas skyong / /zas dug can dang 'dra ba'i gnyen 'khor rnams/ /thabs mkhas pa yi sgo nas spongs bar gyis/ /de ma spangs na nyon mongs 'di nyid du/ /mi rang gzhan kun bying ba'i nyen yod do/ /las byed rgyu la thos bsam sgom gsum sogs/ /bstan phan pa yi bya bas dus kun 'da'/ /mi kho bo yi bsam pa'i don 'di rnams/ /sna gcig nyid kyang ma lus mthar phyin par/ /mtshan thos pa tsam dka' ba'i mus pa rje/

/pha mtshungs med khyed kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /nga gong ma yi gsung rab la dad pas/ /nang phu mda' med glegs bam mang pos gang / /nga dben pa ru sems nyid skyo ba'i tshe/ /grogs blo ldan gyi sems gso med lags na'ang / /rje gong ma yi gsung rab rgya mtsho yis/ /dus rgyun du rang sems kyi ngal gso mdzad/ /'di bsam gyin yang bkur bsti yang dag bsgrub/ /dus da dung yang kho bo sems skyo na/ /grogs khyed nyid la re 'o gsung rab rnams/ /thugs ma mnyel bar mdzod cig glegs bam dag /skyon yon tan nam khe nyen rnam gnyis las/ /chos phyi ma yi ma gos gsung rab la/ /nged blo ldan rnams skyo rogs 'chol ba yin/ /gzhan col chung 'ga' yi skyo rogs 'chol ba de/ /cung phal gyi rang dogs 'dir ma bris/ /da rtog 'gyu yi rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /nga rtogs ldan gyi nyams len 'di ltar byed/ /chos snang srid kun sems yin sems skye med/ /don skye med do snyam pa'ang 'khrul pa ste/ /rgyu de bas na khas len dang bral ba'i/ /sems bde stong gi ngang la lhod de 'jog /gnad 'di nyid la nges shes skyes gyur na/ /gegs bar chod kyi dogs pa la sogs pa'i/ /sems 'khrul snang kun rang bzhin 'gro yin 'dug /ha ha zhes pa 'di yang rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i bsnyen pa byas dus kyi nyams dbyangs nyams rtags bskyed pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs/134 /rje rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje chos/ /mtshan bud+dhar grags pa'i mus pa rje/ /pha 'gran zla dang bral mgon khyod la/ /bdag bsam bzhin dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /dus byang chub bar du thugs rjes zungs/ /rgyud kun gyi yangs rtse gsang mtha'i lam/ /yid brtson pas nyams su blangs ba'i mthus/ /nang zag med bde stong rol pa la/ /phyi drug cu rtsa gnyis lha yi sku/ /dus nyin mtshan med par dag snang dang /

/phyi brtan g.yo thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor/ /sgra gsang sngags gnyis med rang sgrar shar/ /sems 'khrul pa'i rtog 'gyu phra rags kun/ /nam byung dus dran pas gso btsugs te/ de bde stong rol par cham gyis bshig /lus 'tsho ba'i bza' btung thams cad kyang / /nang zab mo lus dkyil mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dus mnyam rjes kun du skabs 'ga' rer/ /sems rang rig 'od gsal rang mdangs dang / /phyi yul snang bsres te 'bol le bzhag /de gsal le sing nge ye rer gnas/ /mdor bsdu na snang srid chos 'di kun/ /'phral dag pa rab 'byams bde stong dang / /don gshis lugs brjod bral ye 'jam che/ /lam zab mo'i gnad bsdus nyams 'di dag /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin dang / /rang rnam dpyod blo gros mi dman pas/ /don go yul tsam la nges shes skyes/ /da myur du mnyam rjes 'dre bar shog /rje mtshan ldan bla mas rjes bzung nas/ /chos zab gnad bcud len byed pa 'di/ /tshe gtan legs 'dun ma zin pa yin/ /tshul 'di las ngo mtshar che ba ci/ /nyams dga' 'o dga' 'o blo re bde/ /zhes pa 'di shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang ba a nan+da'i ming can gyis slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen pa la rtse gcig tu gnas skabs nyams la gang shar gsal 'debs kyi tshul du bris nas mjug cung zad ma rdzogs pa'i snga dro'i cha zhig rmi lam du rgyal ba mus pa chen po dang mjal nas lam dus kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pas byin brlabs 'dra ba zhig mdzad gyin 'dug pas nang nas bram ze chen po dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho gsum gyi mtshan gsal bar thos pa'i mod la/ rang nyid la snga gong nas 'od gsal 'char ba'i snga ltas 'dra ba'i nyams zhig 'char rgyu yod pa de shar byung ba nas/ de'i rkyen byas nas gnyid sad byung bas sems dga' spro dpag tu med pa dang ldan bzhin pa'i ngang nas nyams dbyangs gi mjug rdzogs par bgyis pa'i gnas ni dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang gi sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gzim chung kun gsal bde chen pho brang ngo /

/'dis skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis gsang sngags zag mo'i nyams len gyi gnad phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rang la rang gis gros 'debs kyi yi ge rang skyon sel ba'i sman mchog bzhugs/135 rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mchog /pha 'khor lo'i mgon po mus pa rje/ /gnas mi mngon dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /bu dad pa can la thugs rjes gzigs/ /da rang la rang gi gros shig 'debs/ /chos sems dang ma 'dres nyams len 'dis/ /dus 'di phyi bar dor phan pa med/ /sems gnas cha med pa'i gang zag la/ /chos sems dang bsres kyang 'dre mi sred/ /sems gnas pa'i rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /khams kun+da pha las thob pa de/ /lam bskyed rdzogs gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /cher 'phel ba rlung dang dbyer med du/ /nang lus kyi rtsa gnas 'gar gram pas/ /ming nang gi mkha' 'gro bcur btags pa'i/ /don rlung sems dwangs ma ro gcig pa'i/ /nang rten 'brel de yi byin rlabs kyis/ /phyi rnam rtog phra rags kun 'gags nas/ /lus bde stong rol par 'char ba dang / /sems gsal stong ngang du lhan gyis 'gro/ /drod de 'dra rgyud la skyes gyur na/ /dus de tshe tha mal snang srid 'di/ /rang lhag pa'i lha yi dkyil 'khor du/ /nam bsgom dus gsal bar 'char ba dang / /de'i steng du sems nyid lhan gyis gnas/ /rgyu des na bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don/ /rang sems dang 'dre bar byed pa la/ sems gnas cha med na mi 'grub cing / /sems gnas par byed pa'i rtsa ba yang / /khams kun+da byang sems dwangs ma ste/ /'di yungs 'bru tsam yang ma nyams pa/ /nang rdo rje lus kyi rtsa gnas su/ /lam zab mo'i thabs kyis bskyangs bar gces/ de ma brjed rang gi sems la zhog /chos kha la ma khyer rgyud la sbyor/ /rje bslu med bla mar blo gtad 'chol/ /rang gces par 'dzin pa'i grogs po dang / /'khor slob ma yon bdag la sogs pa/

/sngon las 'brel bzhag pa'i yul rnams la/ /'phral brtse dung drag pos ma bcings par/ /yid bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa ru/ /skyabs bslu med rnams la gsol ba thob/ /yid nyon mongs 'phel ba'i gnas dang grogs/ /thabs mkhas pas spongs la snying rje sgoms/ /'phral zas nor kun la chog shes bsten/ /stobs che na dkon mchog zhing la phul/ /lus dal 'byor lan gcig thob dus 'dir/ /tshe 'dir snang a 'thas rgyun bcad de/ /dus gtan legs 'dun ma ma bsgrub na/ /mi khyod la gcig tu blo gtad pa'i/ /khong gshin gson rnams bslus par mi 'gyur ram/ /yid khrel med khyod gzhan rnams mi bsam kyang / /rang dmyal bar 'gro ba phod pa gda' 'am/ /rang rang gi ma bslu rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes pa 'di ni snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs la grags pa'i yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan de nyid las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin thob pa'i skal ba bzang po can shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang gi yangs rtse e waṃ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas su rang la rang gis gros 'debs kyi tshul du bris pa 'dis rang gzhan kun la phan par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/136 gu ṇa rat+na ka ra: bud+dha dh+wa dza ya na ma: rje 'khrul zad sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa/ /khyed dus gsum rgyal ba'i mthu bsdus nas/ /dus lung dus bstan pa'i mjug 'di la/ /mi bdag sogs 'gro ba bsgral ba'i phyir/ /tshul bshes gnyen chen po'i skur bstan pa/ /bdag nges shes gting nas skyes par 'gyur/ /gnad 'di yi legs pa'i rtsa ba tshugs/ /tshul 'di yang bla ma'i thugs rje yin/ /drin 'khor mtha' med pa'i mus pa rje/

/sprang ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can la/ /skyabs gzhan na med do dgongs par mdzod/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub 'bad med stsol/ /rang dben par thos bsam spyad pa'i tshe/ /sems skyo ba 'ga' zhig 'dir smras pa/ /dus deng sang skabs kyi mi phal cher/ /tshe 'dir snang kho na la zhen pas/ /rten dal 'byor stong log byed 'di skyo/ /khong rab byung blo gsal 'ga' zhig kyang / /gzhan 'jig rten grags bde'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /blo shes bya sbyong long med 'di skyo/ /bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya mtsho'i don/ /blo sbyang pa bgyid pa'i gang zag la/ /gzhan blun pos skyon brjod byed 'di skyo/ /blo rab gsal skye bo gzhon nu dag /grogs rnam dpyod ldan dang lhan cig tu/ /gnas bcas na yon tan gong 'phel 'gyur/ /tshul 'di yang shin tu dkon 'di skyo/ /rang dkon mchog dpang bzhag las byas kyang / /gzhan skye bo nyon mongs cher rags pas/ /ci byas kyang smod tshig smra 'di skyo/ /thabs du mas mgu bar byas na yang / /rgyud shing las gyong ba'i gnyen 'khor de/ /ngag btsun yang spu med phag pa yin/ /tshul 'di la bsam bzhin yang yang skyo/ /rang bde yang gzhan dag bde dogs pas/ /sems ngan pa rgyun mar 'chang bzhin du/ /'phral spyod pa bcos med ltar byed pa'i/ /mi de la kho bo gting nas skyo/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar skyong 'dod pa'i/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyod pa dang / /blo gang shar lag len byed pa gnyis/ /khyad med pa 'ga' yi 'dzin de skyong / /sngon thos bsam bgyid pa'i gang zag de/ /gzhan dam pa bu ltar brtse bas skyong / /dus deng sang de las ldog 'di skyo/ /chos 'chad dang rtsod dang rtsom pa yis/ /bstan gsal bar nus pa'i skyes bu de/ /dus 'di na nyin mo'i skar las dkon/ /'ga' rnam dpyod blo gros mi dman pas/ /tshul de ltar bgyid 'dod yod na yang / /bstan 'phel dogs gzhan gyi dgag 'di skyo/

/lar ding sang skabs kyi gnas tshul rnams/ /gang bsam kyang skyo ba'i rgyur 'dug pas/ /da rnam rtog thol skyes rbad bcad nas/ /skyabs bslu med rnams la don 'di zhu/ /skyon kun bral yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /yongs 'gro mgon zas gtsang sras po dang / /de'i bstan pa dri med gsal ba la/ /gnas 'phags pa'i yul du rim byon pa'i/ /dgra bcom pa ji snyed de dag dang / /der ma zad rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ /bzang rim par byon pa thams cad dang / /bod gangs can mun pa'i gling 'di ru/ /chos zab yang sgron me sbar mdzad pa'i/ /drin 'khor med lo tsā che rnams dang / /chos skyong ba'i rgyal blon byang sems che/ /rim par byon pa rnams dang de rjes su'ang / /bstan gsal mdzad skyes chen gang byon pa/ /de rnams dang khyad par dri med pa'i/ /bstan yongs rdzogs bdag po sa skya pa/ /khyed yab sras brgyud par bcas rnams dang / /skyabs kun 'dus bud+dha'i mtshan can rnams/ /mi bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /dus ngan pa deng sang skabs 'di na/ /bstan bsam pa'i skye bo gser las dkon/ /'ga' yod kyang don de 'grub pa dka'/ /rgyu des na bdag sogs sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan spyi dang bye brag rgyas 'dod pa'i/ /tshogs bsags pa'i skyes bu thams cad kyi/ /don ma lus 'bad med mthar phyin pa/ /khyed mkhyen brtse nus ldan rnams kyis mdzod/ /bdag kha zhe med do dkon mchog mkhyen/ /ces pa 'di shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lam zab bla ma rin 'byung nyams len 'bad rtsol bgyid pa'i ngang nas me pho 'brug gi lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i nyer gcig kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge zab mo chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul pa'i nyin bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bur bris pa'o/

/'di bgyis dge bas bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi bsam don ma lus par mthar phyin par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs bar chad kun sel bzhugs/137 'dir smras pa/ pha 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /pha 'jig rten mgon pos thugs rjes gzigs/ /pha gsang ba'i bdag pos dge legs mdzod/ /pha mkhyen brtse nus ldan dgongs su gsol/ /bdag lung dus bstan pa'i mjug 'di la/ /sngon bsags pa'i las kyi dbang gis skyes/ /rgyu dug gsum kho na'i gter mdzod can/ /mi bdag 'dras gzhan dag yar 'dren pa'i/ /sems 'di ni ngo tsha bor bas lan/ /de shes pas zhu don 'di ltar lags/ /bdag gzhon nu nyid nas rab byung 'dod/ /don de nyid 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje/ /mgon nyid kyi drin las grub pas rjes/ /bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya mtsho yis/ /don kun la thogs med gdeng thob phyir/ /blo sbyangs pa mthar phyin bgyid snyam pa'i/ /yid drag po yod kyang dus da bar/ /sems le lo'i dbang dang mthun pa'i rkyen/ /kun tshangs par ma gyur de 'gyang lags/ /da don de 'bad nas bsgrub 'di la/ /gegs bar gcod ci mchis ma lus pa/ /rje yid bzhin nor bu dang mtshungs pa'i/ /pha nyid kyi thugs rjes zhi bar mdzod/ /don ma lus mthar phyin mdzad du gsol/ /der ma zad zhu don 'di ltar te/ /rje mtshan ldan da dung 'ga' rnyed nas/ /chos zab yangs yongs rdzogs legs mnos nas/ /pha nyid las thob pa'i zab chos dang / /rje gzhan las mnos pa'i chos tshul rnams/ /don kha bshad tsam du ma lus pa/ /nyams rtogs pa'i gdengs dang ldan pa ru/ /mgon brtse ldan khyod kyis mdzad du gsol/ /don de dag rim bzhin 'grub pa'i rjes/ /chos 'khor lo 'bad pas bskor ba dang / /bu brgyud 'dzin bshes gnyen nyi zla ltar/ /grags che zhing skar phran ltar mang ba'i/ /stod mnga' ris smad phyogs mdo khams dang /

/bar dbus gtsang thams cad khyab gyur nas/ /dpal sa skya'i rang lugs gtsor gyur pa'i/ /bstan dri med che cher 'phel ba dang / /de yun du gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ /don bsdu ba'i zhu don 'di ltar lags/ /bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub bar/ /skyid sdug dang legs nyes gang byung yang / /'gran do med bla ma khyed rang mkhyen/ /khyed ma gtogs re sa gzhan na med/ /thugs brtse bas skad cig tsam ma gtong / /zhes bya ba ni 'khon rigs shākya seng ge yi/ /btsun pa rgya'o ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ chos mthun don rnams bsgrub pa la bar gcod mi 'byung phyir/ yon tan 'byung gnas dpal ldan sa skyar myur bar bris/ /bud+dha bo dhi sa twa ma la dgyes par gyur cig/ ༈ //nyams dbyangs phun tshogs rab rgyas bzhugs/138 skyabs bslu med thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /skyabs gcig chog rgyal po mus pa rje/ /skyabs zur 'tshol med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /skyabs byang chub bar du mdzad du gsol/ /rje mtshungs bral khyod kyi thugs rje yis/ /mi bdag la thun mong dngos grub tu/ /khong dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba rnams/ /don rang gi ngang gis dbang du 'dus/ /nor 'dod dgu'i longs spyod char ltar 'bab/ /kho log bsgrub byed pa'i bstan dgra rnams/ /dus lo zla ma 'gyang srung mas bsgral/ /ljongs gangs can bod kyi rdo rje gdan/ /dpal sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rnams/ /dpe yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du rgyas/ /phyogs gang nas bltas kyang dga' dga' 'dra/ /dpal phun tshogs ma lus stsol mdzad pa'i/ /drin 'khor med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mgon khyod kyi man ngag bdud rtsi yis/ /gnad lam khyer zab mo'i byin rlabs kyi/ /tshe 'dir snang phun sum gang tshogs kyang / /bu mi 'ching grol ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba/ /pha thugs rje can gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /rje bslu med khyed la yid gtad pa'i/ /mi bdag dang bdag la ltos bcas rnams/

/dus 'di la tshe ring nad med cing / /yid bsam don thams cad 'grub pa dang / /tshe phyi ma dag pa'i zhing gi mchog /gnas bde ba can du drang du gsol/ /pha sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /mgon khyed kyi thugs rjes ma gzigs na/ /bdag bag chags ngan pa cher 'thug pas/ /blo tha mal snang bas nyes len 'phrogs/ /'phral gzhan blo 'khrid sogs zar zir gyis/ /ban bun gyi ngang la nyi ma bskyel/ /mtshan phal cher ro nyal ngang du lus/ /ming bstan pa'i bya bar btags pa yi/ /lus ngag dge ba la bskul lo sogs/ /gzhan mig sngar mdzes pa'i chos khyad kyis/ /lo zla dang zhag kun de kas 'da'/ /rgyu des na mi tshe stong zad nye/ /'on kyang rung bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /chos nyams len yang snying 'di ltar byas/ /phyogs dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ snang srid pa 'di dag lha'i dkyil 'khor/ sgra thos tshad gsang sngags rang sgrar bsgom/ yid rtog 'gyu dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs/ /de kun kyang mtshan ldan bla ma yis/ /don rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo ru/ /chos gdod ma'i gnas lugs ro gcig phyir/ /de rang ngo shes pa'i tshul nyid du/ /blo dran 'dun yang yang bskyed de bsgom/ /kun sems snang sems kyang sgyu ma 'dra/ /don sgyu ma'i gnas lugs brjod bral ngang / gnad 'di la dang po khrims bsgrim pas/ /blo tha mal rnam rtog kun 'gags nas/ /yid dag snang ngang la yug re bzhag /de bde gsal mi rtog ngang shig ste /dbyings rig pa dbyer med bde stong gis/ /shis gzhi med rtsa bral lhan skyes ngang / /don de la zhen med gsal le bzhag /gnad 'di la 'byongs pa'i phan yon gyis/ /rang 'chi khar phyi yi 'pho ba de/ /rab thebs nas mkha' spyod 'grub par shog /de min na'ang 'od gsal ma bu gnyis/ /ro gcig tu 'dres dus ngo shes nas/ /don nang gi 'pho ba zab mo yi/ /dus skad cig de la bdag grol nas/ /khong pha mar gyur pa'i sems can kun/

/gnas dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid par shog /mi bdag gi bsam pa'i don 'di rnams/ /yid bzhin du 'grub pa bla ma'i mchog /pha mtshungs bral khyed kyi byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang skyabs gnas kun 'dus rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi bka' drin dran pa'i mod la sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba 'dis phyogs dus kun du dge legs dang ldan par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams mgur snyigs ma'i gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs/139 rje gzhon nu'i dus su thos bsam spyad/ /sku dar la babs dus bsgrub pas grol/ /mthar sku tshe'i smad la gzhan don bskyangs/ /dus da lta mkha' spyod 'og min na/ /lha dkyil 'khor zhi khro rab 'byams kyi/ /tshogs gtso bo mdzad pa'i skyes chen de/ /mi kho bos bla ma mus pa rje/ /pha sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan ma lags sam/ /mgon de 'dra'i bu gcig ltar bskyangs pa'i/ /nga rnal 'byor skal bzang blo re bde/ /skyabs zur 'tshol med pa'i mus chen rje/ /bu dad ldan slob mar bcas pa rnams/ /pha khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ /lar dus ngan 'di la bdag skyes pas/ /bstan 'gro la phan pa shin tu dka'/ /rje dus gsum rgyal bas ma thul ba'i/ /kho gdul bya bsod nams dman 'di dag /gang byas kyang thul bar dka' ba gda'/ /khong 'di tsho'i rnam thar mdo tsam bshad/ /dus gtan gyi skyabs gnas bla ma la'ang / /rang mnos na nga yi bla ma zer/ /rang ma mnos bla ma khyir mi rtsi/ /'ga' don med kun slong rmongs zhen gyi/ /bstan gsal bar nus nges skyes chen las/ /chos gang la'ang rmongs pa'i yul la bstod/ /tshe 'di la sangs rgyas 'grub nus pa'i/ /chos zab yangs bdud rtsi byin pa bas/ /nor zang zing byin pa drin du 'dzin/

/'ga' byas med yus kyis khog pa khang / /'ga' blun rig spyod pas shes rgyud dkrug /'ga' lugs gnyis chos la rab rmongs yang / /nga na tshod rgan pas bzang ngo zhes/ /gzhan dpyod ldan gzhon nu rnams la smod/ /khong dam pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig gis/ /bstan spel ba'i mdzad 'phrin ngo mtshar las/ /bstan 'phel ba dngos su mthong na yang / /kho gang la'ang rmongs pa'i rgan po 'gas/ /'di sngon med ltas ngan 'dra bar smod/ /'ga' lo zlar bsam mno rab btang nas/ /khong dpyod ldan gzur gnas dam pa la/ /don gzhi med skur 'debs 'bad nas byed/ /mdor bsdu na deng dus gdul bya rnams/ /blo dpyod ldan gzur gnas cher dkon pas/ /rang phyogs mthun bdud sprul 'dra ba yang / /de sna tshogs thabs kyis bstod cing bkur/ /rang phyogs mi mthun na dam pa yang / /tshul du ma'i sgo nas smod pa mthong / /don rnam dpyod ldan dang blun po dang / /khong dam pa'i skyes dang ngan pa gnyis/ /don sor sor 'byed shes cher dkon zhing / /'ga' yod kyang drang po gzur gnas pa/ /dus ding sang nyin mo'i skar las dkon/ /rgyu des na bdag gi bstan bsam pa'i/ /las spyod pa ji snyed byas pa la/ /khong ngan lang shor ba'i blun po rnams/ /dus rgyun du mgu bar ma gyur bas/ /kun dga' ba'i thabs ni ngas ma shes/ /rgyu des na lus sems cher ngal ba'i/ /bstan mi zin 'dzin re blo skyungs nas/ /chos mthun pa'i mthun rkyen 'joms dus 'dir/ /tshe gtan legs kyi 'dun ma zin nges pa'i/ /chos bsgrub la chig bsgril byed snyam sems/ /lar sngon gyi skyes chen thams cad dang / /skyon kun bral yon tan kun ldan pas/ /khong ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la'ang / /kho bsod nams med pa'i skye bo 'gas/ /thabs du mas rab tu smad do zhes/ /bka' gsung rab rnams las bshad pa mthong / /rgyu des na dus ngan 'di 'dra la/ /kho ngan pa rnams kyi gang smos kyang /

/rang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i khur len pa/ /khong rdzogs sangs rgyas ltar skal ba bzang / /sngar yan kyang bstan la phan pa byung / /dus da dung bsam don kun 'grub nas/ /bstan yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa dang / /tshe phyi ma bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /gnas bde ba can gyi zhing skye bar/ /pha gcig chog rgyal pos byin gyis rlobs/ /tshul de skad smra ba sa skya pa/ /ming ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /rje bla ma las gzhan du mi re ba'i/ /chos yang rtse'i zab gnad rig de'o/ /tshul 'di ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /dus kun du bsam don kun 'grub shog /bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshigs su bcad pa rang gi spyod tshul la yid 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad lhan cig tu bsdebs pa bzhugs/140 rje rdo rje 'chang chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tha mal rtog pas bslad pa'i snang srid 'di/ /nyin mtshan 'khor yug dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor/ /de yang snang stong gsal stong bde stong ngang / /mdor na tha mal rtog pas ma gos pa'i/ /nyams len mthar phyin bdag gi bla ma de/ /dag pa'i zhing khams gang na bzhugs kyang rung / /dad ldan bdag la thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po khyod kyi drin las rang nyid kyi/ /brtson pas bsgrub na rdo rje 'chang chen yang / /tshe 'dir 'grub la yid gnyis dang bral ba'i/ /man ngag rgya mtsho lta bu legs nos kyang / /sna tshogs tshe 'dis snang ba khrid mkhas pa'i/ /dus skabs phal cher za nyal 'chag gsum gyi/ /bag med spyod pa 'jig rten pa ltar lus/ /skabs 'gar snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas su/ /'bad pas bsgom kyang dag snang de'i ngang la/ /rang sems skad cig tsam yang gnas ma nus/ /de bzhin chos kun gshis lugs brjod bral la/ /dran 'dun drag pos yang yang sems bzhag kyang / /bde stong ngang du sing nge ye re ba/ /cung zad tsam yang gnas pa'i mthu ma rnyed/

/de phyir sems dang ma bral nyams len 'di'i/ /chos par grags pa'i ming stong sgra che yang / /gnyis phung las la sbyar dogs sems re 'tshab/ /de ltar na yang mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan nges bla ma yis/ /byang chub bar du 'bral ba med do zhes/ /rmad byung zhal bzhes bdag la dgyes bzhin gnang / /de phyir bdag dang bdag gi gdul bya rnams/ /tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun bla ma yis/ /zhabs pad brtan zhing thugs kyi rjes bzung te/ /myur du yan lag bdun ldan mngon gyur shog /tshul 'di shākya'i dge slong ā nan+das/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i yon tan dran pa dang / /rang gi spyod pa'i tshul la yid 'byung nas/ /gnas mchog chu mig rdzing khar myur bar bsdebs/ /dge bas rang gzhan don kun 'grub gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bdag bstod bskul byed rab dga' bzhugs/141 na mo gu ru/ 'dir smras pa/ dri med gzhung brgya 'chad la thogs pa med/ /khrims ldan 'dul ba 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyan/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin mchog ldan sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga'i mtshan can zhabs la 'dud/ /ces pa 'di ni bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ byi ba la ni glang chen dpe/ /phyug po la ni rnam thos bu/ /rgyal phran la yang brgya byin dpe/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal pa la'ang / /sangs rgyas lta bu'i bsngags pa ni/ /snyan ngag mkhan la bkag pa med/ /ces pa'i don yid la bzhag nas/ /rang la gong du bkod pa'i yon tan gyi cha tsham med kyang / mi phyed dad pa dang ldan pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag mo dbyangs can bsod nams rgyal mos 'bum gter gsog bde ba'i phyir bdag bstod nyung ngu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba la brten nas sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis 'byung gi yon tan 'ga' zhig la smon pa'i tshul gyis smras pa 'di re zhig rdzogs so/ /maṅga laṃ// ༈ //nyams shar yi ger bris pa blo ldan dga' bskyed ces bya ba bzhugs/142

'dir smras pa/ bsam pa ngan zhing sbyor ba rtsub pa yis/ /dus rnams kun du gnod pa bskyal ba'i lan/ /phan pa chen po yongs grags bsgrub na yang / /yang lan gnod pa kho nas mjal ba yis/ /nye du de la re thag bcad na legs/ /rgyun du bla ma bzhin du bsten na yang / /ngan spyod mang pos sems la ngal ba bskyed/ /rang nyid sdug tshe dgra ltar gnod la dga'/ /de lta'i gros la re thag bcad na legs/ /bza' btung byin na dka' ba dwangs len cing / /de min sla na'ang gzhan don mi bsgrub la/ /snying gtam kun la sgrog par byed pa yis/ /skyes bu de'ang re thag bcad na legs/ /kun las lhag snyam nga rgyal rgyud gang zhing / /gzhan dag mthun la lhag par mi dga' bas/ /mtho dman rab gsum thams cad dkrug byed pa'i/ /mi de la yang re thag bcad na legs/ /rgyun du ngag 'jam sems bzang blo gros gsal/ /smra ba mi mang gzhan phyir srog kyang gtong / /chos min spyod la nam yang mi dga' ba'i/ /skyes bu de la gtan grogs bcol na legs/ /shes bya'i gnas kun sbyangs pa mthar phyin zhing / /zab rgyas gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod dang ldan/ /bstan la phan pa'i bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/ /bshes gnyen de la bla ma bcol na legs/ /dam pa dkon mchog bzhin du bsten pa dang / /ngan pa dug can zas ltar spongs ba dang / /rang nyid lhun po bzhin du rab brtan pa/ /'di gsum blo ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i don la legs sbyangs shing / /'dren pa mang po'i gdams pa yongs nos nas/ /bde legs rtsa ba bstan pa rab spel te/ /rang gzhan 'di phyir legs pa'i gzhi bsgrub pa/ /'di yang blo ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ /deng sang 'di na de ltar bgyid 'dod pa/ /nyin mo'i skar bzhin srid pa tsam du snang / /snang ba de la brtse ba'i skyes bu la/ /ngal ba sna tshogs rgyun du 'byung ba mthong / /tshul 'di mtshon nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/

/bstan pa'i nyi ma nub ri'i rtse la nye/ /dus ngan 'di la tshogs ma bsags bdag skyes/ /yid la re ba'i don rnams 'grub par dka'/ /de phyir bdag gi bsam don bsgrub pa'i grogs/ /'khrul pa'i dri med rje btsun sa skya pa/ /gong ma rim par byon pa khyed rnams dang / /skyabs gnas kun 'dus budha'i mtshan la zhu/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bur bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs ngan pa spyod pa'i zug rngu sel byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/143 /'dir smras pa/ sprang rnal 'byor ngag dbang kun bsod dang / /tshogs bsags la ma bsags gnyis su byung / /tshogs bsags pas dal 'byor mchog 'di thob/ /sngon sbyangs pas skyes stobs blo gros gsal/ /lo gzhon nu nyid nas chos sgor zhugs/ /rje mtshan ldan bla mas bu bzhin bskyangs/ /sngon byon pa'i gong ma'i rnam thar rnams/ /tshul bzhin du skyong bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ /gzhan grags bde'i rjes su mi 'brangs bar/ /las chos mthun kho nas dus kun 'da'/ /tshogs ma bsags pas chos mthun skyes bu la/ /mthun rkyen rnams dkon pa'i dus 'dir skyes/ /rgyu des na blo ldan kho bo la/ /zas gos nor gsum gyis ma 'phongs kyang / /ngan pa'i 'khor 'ga' zhig spyod ngan gyis/ /dus rgyun du shes rgyud yang yang dkrug /khong 'ga' zhig kha 'jam sems gdug gis/ /rang gzhan gnyis phung ba'i sa bon 'debs/ /'bras ngan de kun la smin pa mthong / /la la dag shes rgyud shing las gyong / /phan sems kyi blang dor ma bstan kyang / /gang shar lag len las 'da' ba med/ /yul de la bcol na bza' btung yang / /tshul bzhin du bya ba shes ma mthong / /de lta'i ngan pa dag nang 'khrugs pas/ /phan tshun kyi spyod ngan sna tshogs kyi/ /kho cag sos dal dang 'byung bzhi'i lus/

/'khrugs dus su'ang me chen 'bar ba la/ /shing skam bsnan pa 'dra'i zug rngu bskyed/ /bskyed kyang rung rtag tu bzod pa bsgom/ /bsgom gyin yang ngan spyod gong 'phel gyur/ /gyur kyang rung blun po 'di dag la/ /dngos su phan sems kyis gang smras kyang / /ngal ba don med rang kho nar 'dug /rgyu des na mi mngon dbyings bzhugs pa'i/ /khyed dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /'khor ngan pa'i phan tshun zhe sdang kun/ /byams snying rjer 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi nged la rnam dpyod ldan pa'i grogs/ /'ga' yod kyang sems nyid ngal dus 'dir/ /khong ngan spyod stobs ldan 'ga' yi rgyu'i/ /phal che bas phan pa mi gda' bas/ /sems brtse dung gi 'khri ba ma gcod par/ /re chen po ma byed rnal 'byor pa/ /kho ngan spyod bgyid pa'i 'khor 'di dag /las drag pos blang dor bya 'os kyang / /khong gong bzhugs thugs rgyud 'khrugs dogs pas/ /dus da lta bya ba'i skabs ma yin/ /rang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob gyur na/ /snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su 'char/ /dus de tshe dgra gnyen dogs pa med/ /rang lugs gnyis 'byor pa rgyas pa'i tshe/ /yul de yi dgra yang gnyen du 'gyur/ /las chos mthun byas kyang nor med na/ /kha drag zhan kun gyis spongs ba de/ /dus deng sang snang tshul yin mod kyang / /mi kho bo sngon bsags las bzang bas/ /sems ha cang ngal rgyu mi gda' ste/ /rje 'brel tshad don ldan bla ma yi/ /bu gcig pa'i ma bzhin brtse bas bskyangs/ /rang chos mthun las kyi dus 'das pas/ /phyogs mtha' med snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ /nga rnam dpyod blo gros rab gsal bas/ /khong chen por 'chos pa phal che las/ /gang byed kyang khyad par 'phags so zhes/ /dus 'di nas kun gyis sgrog par byed/ /khong bshes gnyen yongs dang blo ldan kun/ /mi kho bos srog ltar gces par 'dzin/ /khong stobs ldan sa skyong rnams kyang dad/

/sngar yan la mthong thos gyur pa rnams/ /phal che ba mi phyed dad la bkod/ /rgyu des na spyi sgos bstan pa 'di/ /mi kho bos gsal bar nus snyam sems/ /'di 'di phyi legs pa'i 'dun ma ste/ /rten dal 'byor thob pa don yod lags/ /tshul 'di las ngo mtshar gzhan ci yod/ /rgyu des na re zhig 'khor ngan sogs/ /chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rab dkon yang / /sngar bzhin du bzod pa rab bsgom nas/ /dus myur du 'jig rten khams 'di yi/ /skyabs gcig pu lta bu 'gyur snyam go /don tshul bzhin 'grub par mngon mkhyen can/ /pha sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan khyod kyis mdzod/ /ces pa 'di rnal 'byor bya bral pa a nan+da'i ming can gyis/ phan med gnod pa'i 'khor 'ga'i spyod pas sems la zug rngu yang yang bskyed pa la rten de nyid bsal phyir myur bar bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs tshe 'di'i zhen pa sel byed ces bya ba bzhugs/144 skyabs rang rig bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu tshe 'di'i bya ba thong bar mdzod/ /sprang rnal 'byor ngag dbang kun bsod ngas/ /gnas sa skyar nam zhig 'dug pa'i tshe/ /mkha' dag pa'i dbyings su sprin 'dus ste/ /mtshan ril po kha ba cher babs nas/ /sang nam langs nyi shar dros pa'i tshe/ /rang 'dug pa'i bsam gtan khang bu yis/ /rje mus pa'i bris sku'i 'og nyid nas/ /gangs bzhu ba'i chu rgyun nyil gyis byung / /de zhi ba'i thabs la 'bad snyam nas/ /lus tab tob lang te las byas pas/ /de ma zhi gzhan yang mang du rdol/ /gcig thabs la mkhas pas zhi gyur kyang / /mi bdag gis sprul pa mi nus pas/ /kun dus gcig sel ba'i thabs ma rnyed/ /nang phu mda' kun gyi 'og gzhi rnams/ /dpe rdzing bu bzhin du chu yi gang / /sems ngal kyang thabs med skyo ba skyes/ /dus de tshe rtog 'gyu 'di ltar shar/ /nga tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thong nas/ /gnas nges med ri khrod 'grims nus na/ /tshul 'di 'dra'i ngal ba ci la 'byung /

/dpe 'dis mtshon tshe 'di'i zhen pa la/ /skyo kho na yod pas nges shes skyes/ /tshe 'dir snang phun sum tshogs gyur kyang / /tshe phyi ma gar 'gro'i gtad med na/ /tshe ci tsam gnas kyang ma nges shing / /tshe 'di bas phyi ma yun ring bas/ /dus da lta'i don las phyi ma'i don/ /gal ci nas bsam kyang che bar gda'/ /lar bshad pa byas na bsgrub pa dran/ /chos bsgrub pa byas na bshad pa dran/ /rang gcig pur bsdad na 'du 'dzi dran/ /gzhan 'dzu 'dzi'i g.yengs tshe dben pa dran/ /gang byas kyang so skye mgu dka' bas/ /blo mang po rtsab rtsob mi bya ba/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar tshul bzhin du/ /mi kho bo snying nas skyong 'dod pas/ /don 'grub par mdzod cig mus pa rje/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis shin tu myur bar smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs gdan sa ma bzhugs/145 rig pa gang shar steng du glod/ /gzhi med rtsa bral rjen ne ltos/ /'khrul pa skyes na 'bur rdungs gyis/ /gang shar bla ma'i rol par bsgom/ /kun kyang brjod med rang so bzung / /gnad 'di ma shes gzhung brgya la/ /mkhas kyang 'chi tshe phan pa med/ /gcig shes kun grol ces pa yang / /gnad 'di min pa logs na med/ /gcig shes mang po shes pa yin/ /gdam ngag ces pa'ang 'di kha yin/ /gsang sngags lam khyer zab zab mor/ /byas kyang gnad 'di kho na yin/ /shes na byas tshad dge sbyor yin/ /ma shes byas tshad g.yengs ba yin/ /gnad 'di shes pas 'khrul pa zhig /rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig smyon pa nga'i/ /ming la sa skya ras chen zer/ /snang srid bla mar khra chems me/ /brjod bral ngang du stong sang nge / /'dzin med ngang du bde cham me/ /ha ha snang ba'i dga' ba la/ /ha ha sna blo yi bde ba la/ /bla ma'i gdam ngag ma thob par/ /yig nag dpe cha'i thos pa de/ /'dzin pa dka' la brjed pa sla/ /de 'dra'i chos kyi gang byed pa/

/sdig gsog pa las drag tsam yin/ /gzhun lugs kun la mkhas na yang / /nyams myong sna gcig gdengs med na/ /kun shes gcig sdug bya ba yin/ /nyams myong gdengs shig yong ba la/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i man ngag dgos/ /kho bos mtshan ldan bla ma rnyed/ /gdams ngag zab dgu mang po thos/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i skal ba yis/ /blo ldan thos bsam dung dung tsho/ /nam 'chi gdengs shig yod lags sam/ /med na 'chi khar man ngag gi /phan gyi thos pas de lta min/ /des na mtshan ldan bla ma las/ /gdams pa zab mo cig bsgril zhig /zhus nas thos bsam spyad byas na/ /legs kyi nyams len gcig med par/ /thos bsam kho na dung dung rang / /byas kyang ngal ba don med lags/ /lar kun dang mi mthun ma yin zhing / /su la'ang chags zhen med pa yi/ /'khri ba rbad chod cig ma nus na/ /gang byas kyang chos su 'gro ba dka'/ /'di sprang po chos med a nan+das/ /blo gang shar bsgrigs legs ma byas par/ /dus yud tsam zhig la bris pa yin/ /sngon byon pa'i grub thob dpal rdor ba'i/ /gsung mgur ma'i gdan sa zin pa yod/ /hai hai/ hā hā hā/ ha ha ha/ sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rje mus chen la zhu yig phul ba'i rten gyi na bza' la phul ba'i yi ge bzhugs/146 rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i zhabs drung du/ /theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba/ /gzugs dang sgra dang sems kyi rtog 'gyu rnams/ /rje btsun nyid dang yi dam dbyer med kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rol par legs shes shing / /de yang rig stong brjed med du shar ba/ /gang des mi phyed dad pa chen pos 'bul/ /chos kyi zab gnad 'di rang yin legs snyam/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje mus chen la zhu yig phul ba'i rten gyi na bza' la bris pa'i yi ge'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //smras pa/ chos med rnal 'byor a nan+da/ /chos nyams len til tsam mi 'dug kyang / /rje grub thob gong ma'i bka' drin gyis/

/rang bsam pa'i 'khyer so 'di bzhin yod/ /gzhi gzhi med rtsa bral gnas lugs de/ /rje rje btsun mus pa'i thugs kyi gshis/ /rang rang sems de dang dbyer med pa/ /bu bu slob kun kyang de yi ngang / /ngang de nas mthong thos rig gsum 'di/ /'di bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su bsgom/ /bsgom de 'dra'i ngang nas rnam g.yengs kun/ /kun bstan 'gro'i don du gyur cig snyam/ /yid lhag bsam mtha' ru phyin pa dang / /dus phyi ma mthong thos dran reg kun/ /zhing bde ba can du kun bgrod par/ /snying thag pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam bgyis/ /zhes kyang rnal 'byor gdod nas rang grol gyis smras so/ /hai// ༈ //sems skyo ba'i ngang nas ro 'dzin bsgyur ba 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa legs bshad yid 'byung bskyed byed ces bya ba bzhugs/147 'dir smras pa/ kye ma deng sang gi dus 'dir/ /gzhon nu blo gsal ba rnams kyang / /dkor gyi dug chu yi myos pa'i/ /sdig can gang zer la nyan nas/ /bshes gnyen spongs ba 'di skyo 'o/ /blang dor shes pa yi mkhas pa/ /srang kha'i rtswa bzhin du bor nas/ /blun po bong bu yi sgra can/ /bstod cing bkur ba 'di skyo yo/ /de phyir shes bya yi tshogs la/ /sbyongs 'dod skye ba ni rab dkon/ /bza' chog tshig rkyang res mi tshe/ /stong zad bskyel ba 'di skyo 'o/ /sngon tshe bla ma yi mchog ni/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum la 'dzin la/ /deng sang nor med kyi bla ma/ /kun gyi spongs ba 'di skyo 'o/ /'das dus snod ldan gyi slob ma/ /zang zing ldan pa la mi ltos/ /deng sang rdzas de dang bral na/ /bla mas spongs ba de skyo 'o/ /dkon mchog dpang btsugs kyi bya ba/ /dus rnams thams cad du byas kyang / /gang dran lag len pa rnams dang / /khyad par med pa 'di skyo 'o/ /glo snying brang gsum po kha zhe/ /med par gtod pa ni cher dkon/ /kha tsam sna tshogs kyi nor rdzas/ /gang khugs byed pa 'di skyo 'o/

/lugs gnyis rnam gzhag la mkhas pa'i/ /skye bo rnam dpyod dang ldan la/ /gang yang mi shes pa'i blun pos/ /yang yang smod pa 'di skyo 'o/ /chos pa rab 'bring pa kun la/ /gtad thub bla ma re dgos kyang / /dus 'dir mtshan ldan gyi bla ma/ /gser bas dkon pa 'di skyo 'o/ /dbang don dag bya dang dag byed/ /rang gi ngo mi shes bzhin du/ /ma smin smin pa ru byas par/ /rlom pa'i bla ma 'di skyo'o/ /de 'dra'i bla ma yi slob ma/ /grol byed lam bsgom pa'i dus su/ /chog bsgrigs tshig rkyang re brjod la/ /mchog tu 'dzin pa 'di skyo 'o/ /sngon gyi rab 'byams pa tshos ni/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho la sbyangs 'dug /deng sang rab 'byams pa 'ga' re/ /gzhung lugs kha cig nas shog grangs/ /bcu phrag gsum tsam re bzung nas/ /de dag zin ma thag de la/ /rab 'byams pa zhes pa'i ming re/ /thogs par byed pa 'di skyo 'o/ /de lta'i rab 'byams pa kha cig /shes rgyud cher rlom gyi gang bas/ /'phral spyod yongs 'dzin pa rnams bzhin/ /'gying zhing lding ba 'di skyo 'o/ /blo gros mig bral ba'i bstod pa'i/ /nor ldan blun po 'di cher mang / /bshes gnyen mkhas pa yi bstod pa'i/ /dpyod ldan dkon pa 'di skyo 'o/ /rgya gar 'phags pa yi yul na/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa bzhin dge bsnyen/ /stong phrag gnyis bas kyang dge tshul/ /gcig nyid lhag pa ru 'dzin yang / /'di na khyim pa bas rab byung / /dman par 'dzin pa 'dzin pa 'di skyo 'o/ /don gyi skyon yon la mi brtag /rang dang phyogs mthun re bsten nas/ /ngan pas ngan pa dag bstod cing / /dam pa smod pa 'di skyo 'o/ /mdor na deng sang gi gnas tshul/ /gang bsam skyo ba las mi 'dug /de kun rang sems 'dis bag chags/ /ngan pa 'thug pa yi lan pa/ /yin pas gnyen po 'di bsten dang / /ngag dbang kun dga' yi ming can ni/ /chos rang sems su 'dug la/ /de yang skye 'gag dang bral bas/

/brjod bral 'dzin med kyi ngang la/ /sing nge yun ring du gnas pas/ /thabs la yang yang du 'bad dang / /myur du lta ba yi mthar thug /rtogs par 'gyur ba la the tshom/ /cung zad tsam zhig kyang med de/ /lta de ma rtogs kyi bar la/ /re sa ltos sa yi bla ma/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /rje btsun bud+dha yi mtshan la/ /kha zhe med pa yi gsol 'debs/ /'bral med thugs rje yi zung la/ /bsam don mthar phyin par mdzod cig /ces pa 'di sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis sems skyo ba'i ngang nas ro 'dzin bsgyur ba 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs gsang ba'i yi ge zhes bya ba bzhugs/148 na mo gu ru bud+dha ya/ phyi ser bu'i rlung gi 'ur sgra dang gcig /nang mar me'i grib so'i srib myur dang gnyis/ /sems skyo ba'i snang tshul dran pa gsum/ /gsum de gsum po 'dzoms pa'i dus de'i tshe/ /tshig shugs 'byung 'ga' byung ba 'dir smras pa/ /bdag byis pa'i dus skyon med sems bzang yang / khong spun ngan gyi gdug rtsub sna tshogs kyi/ /dus rgyun du rang yid chad kho na 'byung / /tshul 'di dag rang dran gyi skyo ba la/ /bdag sngon bsags kyi las bzang rab byung 'dod/ /tshe 'dir snang gi a 'thas ma 'dod pas/ /khong gnyen 'dun dang thugs yid cung ma 'dres/ /de'i gnas tshul rnams bsam gyin skyo ba la/ /bdag phyogs med kyi gzhung lugs sbyong 'dod pas/ /don 'grub pa yi thabs gang byas kyang / /khong gong bzhugs kyi gnang ba ma thob pas/ /dus yun ring du 'gyang 'di skyo ba la/ /da thos bsam dag byed pa'i skabs shar yang / /grogs bshes gnyen sogs de'i mthun rkyen rnams/ /phal che ba dag tshangs par ma gyur pa'i/ /las ngan pa'i snang tshul 'di skyo ba la/ /bdag rnam dpyod kyi blo gros mi dman pas/ /mi rang gzhan kun gcig tu dad pa la/ /dgra nag po ltar gnyen rnams khong khro ba'i/

/srol ngan pa 'di bsam gyin skyo ba la/ /khong 'ga' zhig thugs bskyed zhan pa'i mthus/ /grogs blo ldan dang cung zad 'grogs dbang med/ /khong blun po yi shes rgyud yang yang dkrug /gang byas kyang rung ngal 'di skyo ba la/ khong stobs ldan gyi dgongs pa rgya chung bas/ /rang snyoms chung gis byas na mthun rkyen med/ /blo gzur gnas zhig byas na khe nyen che/ /sprang tshogs ma bsags kho bo skyo ba la/ /khong dpyod ldan gyi skyes bu 'ga' zhig la/ /thabs sna tshogs kyis phan pa bsgrub legs na'ang / /rang ngal dus su cung zad phan ma myong / /tshul 'di 'dra bsam na skyo ba la/ /khong gtad thub kyi blo ldan 'ga' zhig la/ /blo kha zhe med 'gyod med byas mod kyang / /khong de tsho yang rang don bsgrub bsgrub nas/ /gzhan zhar byung du byed 'di skyo ba la/ /don dgos dus rang la mi phan pa'i/ /khong mdza' grogs dag blo gros gsal ldan yang / /mi gzhan nor la che brjod byas pa ltar/ /las rjes med 'di bsam gyin skyo ba la/ /spyir so skye yi grogs la yid ma song / /dgos deng sang gi grogs dag nyon mongs rgyu/ /sems re 'dod dag bcad na legs pa yis/ /yul 'di dag la bsam gyin skyo ba la/ /rje gong ma yi rnam thar skyong 'dod pa/ /gnas 'di nyid na deng sang kho bo tsam/ /blo chos mthun la mthun rkyen rab dkon pa'i/ /dus ngan pa 'dir skyes bdag skyo ba la/ /blo gang dran dag lag len byas rnams rgyal/ /mi gzhan sems dang 'gal dogs byas rnams pham/ /don blo ldan rnams rtag tu ngal ba 'di/ /mi phal cher gyi ma nges skyo ba la/ /rgyu 'phags nor gyis phyug pa'i gang zag dang / /chos gang la yang rmongs pa'i blun po gnyis/ /khyad cung zad kyang med par 'dzin pa yi/ /lugs ngan pa 'di bsam gyin skyo ba la/ /khong lugs gnyis la rmongs pa'i ngan pa dag /gzhan lugs gnyis la mkhas pa rgyun du smod/ /chos lugs gnyis kyi khrims dang bral ba'i gnas/

/'dis gnas tshul rnams bsam gyin skyo ba la/ /zhes pa 'di sprang po chos med a nan+da'i ming can gyis shin tu myur bar smras pa'o/ /yang smras pa/ kye ma deng sang gi gnas 'dis/ /snang tshul gang la rang bsam kyang / /skyo ba snying nas rang skyes so/ /tshul 'di bsam gyin rang kho bo/ /sngags 'chang bla ma de dran no/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rin kho dran no/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog de dran no/ /dran kyang las ngan gyi dbang gis/ /zhal mjal skal ba ni ma byung / /snying nas dad pa yi gsol 'debs/ /kun gyis mi mngon pa'i dbyings nas/ /dmigs med thugs rje yis gzigs la/ /mgon med skyabs med kyi sprang po/ /ngag dbang kun bsod pa bdag gi /chos mthun bsam don tshogs 'di dag /'bad med 'grub pa rang mdzod cig /khyed shes khyed mkhyen rang lags pas/ /skad cig thugs rje yis ma gtong / /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs ang bzhi ma bzhugs/149 'dir smras pa/ sngon byon pa'i skyes mchog sprul pa'i sku/ /rje sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun rin dang / /skyabs kun 'dus rgyal ba mos pa rje/ /sprang mgon med skyabs med rnal 'byor la/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos rgyang nas gzigs/ /dus 'du 'bral med par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag blo mthun grogs dang lhan cig pas/ /phyogs mtha' med rgyal khams 'grims 'dod nas/ /'dis mi bslu'am snyam pa'i grogs dag la/ /thabs du mas mgu bar legs na'ang / /khong gzhan gyi bsam pa rgya che che'i/ /tshig smra mkhas zol gyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /mi bdag la byin pa'i rloms sems kyi/ /tshig legs legs blo kha tshims 'dod pa/ /'di 'thad pa 'dug gam dpyod ldan tsho/ /spyir bsam pa gang che'i gang zag la/ /mi kho bo'ang rjes su yi rang mod/ /dus deng sang bsam pa rgya ches na/ /don rang 'dod bsgrub pa'i go skabs med/ /rgyu des na phugs su legs 'dod na/ /dus da lta bza' btung spongs sam ang /

/'di legs par som dang grogs mchog rnams/ /mi khyod kyi da lta'i bsam pa 'di/ /dpe yan lag brgyad ldan chab 'gram du/ /chu ba tshwa can la zhen min nam/ /blo dpyod ldan yin nam som dang ang / /sprang tshogs ma bsags nga dus ngan 'dir/ /las ngan pa'i dbang gis skyes pa'i phyir/ /dus re zhig ji ltar byas kyang ngal/ /phugs bslu med dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /gang byas kyang bde legs 'byung snyam sems/ /spyir dpon dang nye 'brel rgan grogs gsum/ /chos 'dun ma legs nyes dri ba'i yul/ /yid mos kyang rang gi rnam dpyod kyi/ /dpyod ma shes rtag tu the tshom rgyu/ /tshul 'di yang yin min bsam dang ang / /da sprang po rang la khrel cig 'debs/ /khyod gzhan sems shes pa med bzhin du/ /khong gzhan gyi blo gtad 'chol snyam pa'i/ /khyod rloms sems can gyi mgo bo 'di/ /khong gzhan gyis bskor ba ma shes sam/ /lar tshe 'di'i bya ba kun btang nas/ /rje rnal 'byor mi la lta bu'am/ /phyogs kun la 'jigs med blo bskyed de/ /chos lugs gnyis ji ltar byed na yang / /blo ya hud bsre ba ma nus na/ /rang dgos don 'grub pa med do ang / /zhes pa'i nyams dbyangs ang bzhi ma/ /'di ni sprang po a nan+da'i/ /shin tu skye ba'i ngang nas bris/ /dkon mchog thugs rjes gzigs gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gdod ma'i bla ma la gsol 'debs kyi yi ge dad pa'i me tog bzhugs/150 rje rang rig bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gang shar tshad legs pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /shis skye ba med pa'i brtan bzhugs 'bul/ /gdod spros dang bral ba'i bstod pa 'bul/ /don zung 'jug ngang du 'bral med bzung / /zhes pa 'di ni rje bla ma mus pa'i drin las legs par rtogs pa sa skya pa a nan+da'i ming can gyis dran gso'i tshul du bsam rtse brang chen yang steng du bris pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ kye ma lung dus bstan pa'i mjug 'di la/

/mtshan ldan bla ma rin chen gser las dkon/ /bstan pa bsam pa'i skye bo nyin skar tsam/ de la'ang mi mthun phyogs kyi rgyun du gos/ 'di la bsam gyin kho bo mchi ma dku/ /thog med dus nas mi dge spyad pa'i mthus/ mtshams med las ngan bsags pa'i skyes bu dag /mgu ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa'i/ /dus ngan 'di la skye nga skyo ba la/ /rtag tu dug chu'i myos pa'i ngag zag rnams/ /yang dag sems ldan rnams la rab 'tshe ba'i/ /ngan pas spyod pa'i sems kyis 'gyur ba'i tshul/ /'di 'dra bsam gyin yang yang yid mug 'phel/ /'on kyang yongs 'dzin mchog gi bka' drin las/ /gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bcud kyi rgyud gtams pa'i/ /sna tshogs rkyen ngan drag po gang byung yang / /ha cang ngal bar 'gyur ba'i skabs ma mchis/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs snying gi mun sel bzhugs/151 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rje ngo mtshar rnam thar mdzad pa'i cha/ /khong yongs 'dzin gzhan dang mtshungs med pa'i/ /pha dus gsum sangs rgyas bud+dha'i mtshan/ /sprang bdag la thugs rjes rgyang nas gzigs/ /dus 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos thun mtshams nyams len gong 'phel mdzod/ /rje dam pa'i drin las legs thob pa'i/ /lam zab mo bsgom pa'i mtshams rnams su/ /las ngan pas slad pa'i lus rten 'di/ /phyi gsal stong rang bzhin lha yi sku/ /nang gdan gsum ngo bo sku bzhi'i bdag /gzugs mthong tshad lha dang bla ma'i sku/ /sgra thos tshad lha dang bla ma'i gsung / /yid rtog 'gyu thams cad bla ma'i thugs/ /tshul de la gsal bar sems zin na/ /yid ma rig log pa'i chos can yin/ /dus de tshe rnam rtog gzhal 'gags nas/ /sems dag snang ngang du gnas de la/ /yid kun btags bral ba'i chos nyid zer/ /tshul de ltar snang ba de kun yang / /don rang gi sems kyi rol pa ste/ /sems de yang gdod nas skye ba med/ /gshis ye stong ye bral nam mkha'i ngang /

/don de la rtse gcig sems zin na/ /lus lha skur gsal ba'i rgya yi btab/ /sku ha cang gsal ba'i yid zhen na/ /sems gnas lugs stong pa'i rgya yis btab/ /don gsal dus stong la stong dus gsal/ /gnad 'di la dang po grims kyis sgrims/ /bar lhod kyis slod la tha mar ni/ /blo res 'jog byed pa man ngag yin/ /rje gong ma'i gsung gi bcud bsdus 'di/ /mi bdag gi le lo'i bdud spangs te/ /dus yang dang yang du bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /nang lus kyi rtsa mdud rnams grol nas/ /phyi yul chen so gnyis legs bgrod de/ /sa ye shes chen po myur thob shog /dus de tshe 'bras bu'i dbang blangs te/ /nang 'gros bzhi thim pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /sku lnga ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /don mthar phyin sangs rgyas de thob nas/ /kun smin grol lam la 'god gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gi bdud rtsis shes rgyud tshim par 'thung ba'i rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis gtsang stod rgyal po'i pho brang gi sa'i cha bsam rtse brang chen yang thog tu 'dir snang gi bya ba gang la yang yid 'byung drag po skyes pa'i rkyen byas nas thun mtshams kyi nyams len gsal 'debs su myur bar bris pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ sems 'khrul pas bslad pa'i 'khor 'das 'di/ /gdod gzhi med rtsa bral nam mkha'i ngang / /don gnas lugs de ltar yin mod kyang / /sems bag chags 'thug pas 'khrul snang la/ /dus snyigs ma'i snang tshul 'di ltar shar/ /khong yongs 'dzin 'dir snang dregs pas khyer/ /bstan bsam pa'i skye bos don mi 'grub/ /khrims bdag po'ang nor phyir khrims ra bshig /khong rigs ldan rgyal sa 'bangs gis 'dzin/ /blo chos mthun bgyis la mi mthun mang / /las khrel med byed rnams go 'phangs mtho/ /yid gzu bor gnas pa'i skyes bu la/ /khong dug chus myos rnams skyon brjod mkhas/

/mdor bsdu na bstan pa nyams dmas pas/ /chos mthun pa'i bsam pa gang bsgrub kyang / /phal che ba 'grub pa'i skabs ma mchis/ /'di bsam gyin snying nas mchi ma dku/ /bstan 'jig la khad pa'i dus ngan 'dir/ /tshe sngon las dbang gis kho bo skyes/ /mi bdag ni bstan pa snying nas bsam/ /rgyu des na mthun grogs nyin skar tsam/ /'di bsam gyin mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /skyabs gzhan na med do mus pa rje/ /pha mkhyen brtse nus ldan khyed nyid kyis/ /bu bdag gi bstan pa'i bya ba rnams/ /gegs med par 'bad med mthar phyin mdzod/ /lar dus ngan deng sang skabs 'di yi/ /las snang tshul sna tshogs mthong ba'i tshe/ /tshe blos btang bsgrub pa tur tur dran/ /'di don gyi lag tu long nges na/ /tshe gtan gyi 'dun ma legs pa yin/ /rang nam 'chi gar skye med bzhin du/ /mi gzhan gyi yar 'dren byed pa 'di/ /mig long bas long ba khrid pa 'dra/ /rgyu des na 'dir snang yud tsam dang / /tshe gtan gyi 'dun ma ma brjed par/ /rje bla ma'i gdams pa zab mo rnams/ /yid brtson pas bsgom na mi legs sam/ /'di som zhig rnal 'byor a n+dan/ /chos bsgrub la le lo'i bdud phyung la/ /rang 'chi nges nam 'chi cha med 'di/ /blo dran pas yang yang gsal btab na/ /yid le lo'i lcags sgrogs grol bar nges/ /rang skyid sdug legs nyes gang byung yang / /chos zab mo'i lam khyer ma shes na/ /rje 'brel tshad don ldan bsten pa dang / /chos zab yangs thos pa don chung bas/ /blo 'dir snang a 'thas rgyun chod la/ /chos dran 'dun bskyed cig rnal 'byor pa/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs ngan pa'i spyod pas zug rngu bskyed pa'i 'bras bu bzhugs/152 na mo gu ru budha dh+wa dza ya/ pha gdod ma'i bla ma rin po che/ /gshis gang du'ang ma grub nam mkha'i ngang / /'phral legs nyes du ma snang ba'i gzhi/ /'di shes na yid bzhin nor bu yin/ /mi nga yi rje btsun mus pa rje/

/pha bud+dha'i drin las cha tsam shes/ /yid sdug btsir mi dgos rang mdangs ltos/ /blo 'bol le lhod de rjen de zhog /gang shar tshad gsal stong ngang du khyer/ /don de ltar yin kyang las ngan gyi/ /'phral bde sdug snang ba 'di ltar shar/ /kye ma kyi hud/ don med zar zir gyi dbus su/ /nyes med rnal 'byor nga 'thums nas/ /tshad med sdug bsngal gyi bsam pa/ /brjed med dran pa 'di skyo'o/ /'di phyi bar do ru phan pa'i/ /dam chos sha ma zhig byed na/ /mang thos nan+da nga'i bla ma/ /rje btsun mus pa 'drar dgos te/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi las kyis/ /'dod dgu sprin bzhin du bsdu ba'i/ /'dir snang 'gran med zhig dgos na/ /gtsang stod rgyal po 'drar dgos so/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yi don du/ /bde gshegs bstan pa 'di spel na/ /sngon dus byon pa yi skyes chen/ /rgyal blon byang sems 'drar dgos so/ /rang don mtha' ru rang phyin nas/ /'gro kun smin grol la bkod de/ /bstan pa'i me ro 'di gso na/ /sa skya'i yab sras 'drar dgos so/ /thos bsam bsgom pa yi 'bras bu/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis sgo nas/ /rang gzhan rnam grol la bkod na/ /rje btsun mus pa 'drar dgos so/ /lto gos gtam gsum sogs tshe 'di'i/ /las la 'khri ba kun bcad nas/ /bya btang sha ma cig byed na/ /mi la ras pa 'drar dgos so/ /zas su dkor nag rang zos nas/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi rang bzhin/ /gnyis phung las ngan la sbyor ba'i/ /snyig dus bla ma yi mdzad pa/ /'di 'dra bsam gyin rang skyo 'o/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog tu btags nas/ /zhabs 'dren kho na rang bsgrub pa'i/ /kha 'jam sems gdug gi dgra 'dis/ /bstan pa'i bshig tshab rang 'di la/ /mkha' 'gro chos srung tshos gzigs la/ /myur du chad pa yi chod dang / /snyigs dus bstan pa 'di bsam na/ /mi 'dod sna tshogs zhig 'byung ba/ /myong bas grub pa rang legs pas/ /bsam pa dag pa yi rnal 'byor/

/kho bo skyid pa dang sdug pa/ /legs nyes gang byung du zin kyang / /'brel tshad don ldan gyi bla ma/ /rje btsun mus pa rang mkhyen no/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rang mkhyen no/ /chos mthun bsam pa yi don rnams/ /'bad med 'grub pa rang mdzod cig /ces pa 'di yang rnal 'byor pa a nan+da'i ming can gyis gtsang stod rgyal po'i pho brang bsam rtse brang chen du myur bar bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs yid bde'i myu gu bzhugs/153 na mo gu ru/ dpal ldan sa skyar ngag dbang kun bsod bde/ /dga' 'o skyid do bstan pa spel zhing bde/ /tshe 'dir bde la phyi ma skyid pa yis/ /don gnyis 'grub pa bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /'di rgyab rten mgur ma'i rta la bskyon la long shig /rang gzhan rna ba'i dga' ston du 'gyur ba legs so/ /zhes pa 'di yang chos med rnal 'byor ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi rab gsal shar du nyams dga' blo bde'i ngang nas bris pa dge legs mchog tu 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //ngan pa'i bsam sbyor la khrel ba'i gtam bzhugs/154 'dir smras pa/ rdo shing lta bur ma dul dregs pa'i sku/ /rje la 'khu ba'i ngan la yid dga' ba'i/ /me khyer 'od kyi kun snang rlom can gyi/ /zer la dga' na blo ldan kun kyang 'khrul/ /ma sbyangs gzhon nu'i dus nas 'gro kun gyis/ /spyi bor zhabs pad zung gi mdzes pa de/ /sa skya'i rje btsun las gzhan 'ga' ma mchis/ /de phyir yul der mi dad dpyod ldan su/ /de lta na yang yid srub rtsa lag 'ga'/ /las kyi bskos pa'i dpon dang bla ma la/ /pho rus dam tshig mi bsam rtag smod cing / /rang gi ngan par bcos pa'i gang zag 'ga'/ /phyis nas dam pa'i rjes zhugs dam pa yi/ /bya ba bsgrub la kun nas zhe sdang zhing / /da dung ngan pa'i spyod la tshod med par/ /rang gi rjes su 'brangs ba yin no cog

/kun kyang bsam pa nag por 'chos pa'i tshig /rang gi rnam shes thog mtha' bar gsum du/ /dug gi sdong por mngon sum ston pa'i ngag /'di 'dra mthong tshe dpyod ldan gad mo bro/ /sngon tshe snyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje yis/ /sa skya paṇa chen pa la phrag dog nas/ /rang gi slob ma 'u yug rig seng de/ /sa paṇa rtsod par re nas sa skyar brdzangs/ /rnam dpyod blo ldan rig pa'i seng ge des/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon bla ma'i yon tan rnams/ /mthong nas rang gi slob dpon rgyang bsrings te/ /rtsod pa lta ci chos rje'i rjes su zhugs/ /deng sang 'di na bdud rigs rlom can 'ga'/ /rang dang 'dra bar rang gi rjes 'brangs du/ /re ba kun la dpon dang bla ma la/ /bsam sbyor log pas 'di phyi gnyis med kyi/ /sa bon gtor kyang kun la theb pa dka'/ /'dir snang bya bar a 'thas shi 'thas kyang / /bya ba btang zhes kun la 'khang pa'i tshig /smras pa 'di sogs ngan sems 'chang ba kun/ /karmā nā thās dbang po'i gzhu 'drar mdzod/ /dus ngan skye bo kha zas dug can ltar/ /su yi brten kyang kun du phung ba'i gzhi/ /bdag la dus gsum kun du yid gnag pa'i/ /'dul dka' mtha' dag bstan srung mchog rnams kyi/ /sngar bzhin myur du chos dbyings bsgral du gsol/ /a kyang da ni rnam rtog 'phro bcad de/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas bye bas ma thul ba'i/ /yul 'di bdag 'dra so skye'i ci la thul/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du bdag skyes nas/ /ma rung dmu rgod 'gro kun der 'dren shog /ces pa 'di dug gi sdong por mtshon pa'i gang zag dag gis rang gi rjes 'brangs su gtogs pa rnams dpon dang bla ma sogs la bsam pa phyin ci log tu 'chos pa'i yi ge ngan pa bkur ba mthong ba'i mod la bris pa'o/ /nyams dbyangs gong ma'i zhu 'phrin bzhugs/155 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ya/ rje lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/

/khyed bstan 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa rnams/ /mi bdag la mi mngon dbyings nas dgongs/ /dus snyigs ma'i snang tshul mthong ba'i tshe/ /bstan yongs rdzogs bdag po'i bstan pa 'di/ /tshe 'di phyi kun du spel snyam sems/ /don de phyir zhu don 'di ltar lags/ /bdag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /don bsam pa'i re ba kun 'grub ste/ /dpal sa skya'i bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /rgyun rigs brgyud gtsang mas rtag skyong mdzod/ /tshe phyi ma bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /lhan cig tu bde ba can skyes nas/ /thabs sna tshogs sprul pa rab bkye ste/ /dpal sa skya'i bstan pas kun khyab mdzod/ /don 'di rnams skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i/ /pha rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /bdag lhag bsam dag pa'i nus mthu yis/ /kun sngar bzhin 'bad med lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi rna thar dran pa'i mod la sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi zhu 'phrin du gsol ba'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rang la smras pa'i nyams dbyangs bzhugs/156 'dir rang la smras pa/ 'dir snang a 'thas kyis dgon gnas kyi 'dzin skyong / /blun po 'ga' bstan pa'i bya ba ru 'dod kyang / /rang gzhan kun gnyis phung gi rtsa bar 'dug pas/ /'di 'dra'i tshul lugs la zhen pa zhig spongs dang / /kye ma sngon bsags kyi dbang gis 'brel ba'i/ /dpon dang mdza' bshes nye 'brel du gyur rnams/ /de dus gnod byed kyi dgra las kyang sdang ba'i/ /gang zag 'di tsho la'ang zhen pa zhig spongs dang / /rang nyid rnam dpyod kyi blo gros gsal bas/ /'phral phugs legs pa'i bya ba zhig byas kyang / /ngan pa tshos yang yang gzhi med kyi skur 'debs/ /byed pa 'di som la ri khrod cig 'grims dang / /'khor g.yog dang gzhan gyi bkur bsti yi zar zir/ /bde bde zhig 'dra yang sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba/ /de bas na gang la'ang ltos med cig byas nas/

/snying nas dam chos la dka' spyad cig mdzod dang / /thos bsam spyod pa sogs bstan pa yi bya ba/ /rlabs chen bgyid pa la mthun rkyen zhig med na/ /ngal ba don med rang kho na ru 'dug pas/ /'khos med snyoms chung gi spyod pa 'di dor dang / /pha rol po ma dga' yi dogs pa rkyang pa/ /dus rgyun du byas na rang don rnams mi 'grub/ /chos ma mthun min pa'i spyod pa zhig byas nas/ /kun dang 'gal kyang rung spyod med zhig som dang / /mi kun gyi mgo bo bskor ba la mkhas snyam/ /kha tsam sna tshogs kyis phan tshun kun dkrugs byed/ /bcos med tshul chos la dus rgyun du 'bad pa'i/ /ngan pa 'di dkon mchog gi chad pa yi chod dang / /khong gzhan gyis kha 'jam sems gdug la brten nas/ /rang mgo nyid thon phyir bcol chung gi blo yis/ /snying thub kyi grogs la rtsoms zol kyi 'grogs lugs/ /byed 'di la phan gnod med pa zhig mdzod dang / /bu bzhin du bskyangs nas ngan spyod kyi rgyud bsregs/ /phan sems kyis smras na tshig ngan gyis sems dkrugs/ /khro gnyer tsam bsdus la ltos med kyi rnam 'gyur/ /ston byed kyi grogs la'ang thabs mkhas kyis 'grogs la/ /ya so dang ldan pa'i ba glang du som dang / /chos mthun bya ba las ma 'das pa'i ngos nas/ /gang la'ang ltos med zhig ma nus par gyur na/ /su la ltos kyang rung sdug bsngal du 'dug pas/ /kun la re 'dod kyi 'khri ba de chod dang / /kha zhe med dkon mchog la blo gtad zhig zhus nas/ /dus rgyun du 'gyod med kyi bya ba zhig byed mod/ /de lta na'ang ngan pa dag dus rtag tu smod kyang / /tshul de la ni ba spu g.yo re rang kan no/ /zhes pa 'di ltos med kyi rnal 'byor pa nan+da'i ming can gyi gu yang blo bde'i ngang nas bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs 'dir snang zhen pa gcod pa'i ral gri bzhugs/157 na mo bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rje dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog

/pha bud+dha'i mtshan gyi dbu mdzad pa'i/ /skyabs rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /mchog thun mong stsol ba'i yi dam lha/ /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /gnas mi mngon dbyings nas kho bo la/ /dus 'du 'bral med par byin gyis rlobs/ /sa gtsang stod rgyal po'i rgyal sa 'di/ /kho 'dir snang can gyis mthong ba'i tshe/ /phyogs kun nas skye bo sprin ltar 'du/ /nor zang zing longs spyod char ltar 'bab/ /phyogs gang nas bltas kyang dga' dga' 'dra/ /dus rgyun du de la yid smon byed/ /blo chos mthun skye bos bltas pa na/ /gnas 'di yi snang tshul gang bsam yang / /las ngan pa sdig dang ma 'brel ba'i/ /cha 'ga' yang yod pa ma mthong phyir/ /phyogs gang nas bsam yang skyo ba 'phel/ /tshe mi rtag 'chi ba tur tur dran/ /yid bcos min snying rje ngang gi skye/ /rgyu des na rnal 'byor a nan+da/ /tshe 'dir snang rnam rtog gang skyes kyang / /rang chos pa yin par dran pa gces/ /zhes pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis gtsang stod rgyal po'i pho brang gzhis dga' bsam rtser slob pa'i tshe gang spyi'i snang tshul mthong ba'i mod la shin tu myur bar smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dus ngan snyigs ma'i snang tshul skyo ba'i gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/158 'dir smras pa/ shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gtsang stod rgyal po'i pho brang gi sa'i cha bsam rtse brang mo cher 'dug pa'i skabs shig /tho rang gi char sleb pa'i dus shig na lus 'tsho ba'i gnyid kyi ma gos shing / lam zab nyams len gyi thun la ma bzhugs tsam gyi bar la bag chags 'thug pa'i dbang gis 'dir snang rtog pa 'phro 'du 'di ltar shar te/ 'o skol ston pa zas gtsang sras 'dis/ /gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bas/ /theg dman theg chen gsang sngags gsum 'byung /
