/de lta'i dri ma med pa'i lam rnams/ /sngon tshe rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes chen rnams kyis/ /thos bsam sgom dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pas/ /dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel bar mdzad do/ /de nas gangs can mun pa'i gling 'dir/ sprul pa'i rgyal blon rnams kyi drin las/ snga dar bstan pa'i nyi ma shar ro/ /der rjes dar mas re zhig bsnubs kyang / /phyi dar bstan pa'i zla ba shar tshe/ /skyes mchog lo paṇa grangs med byon nas/ /bshad brgyud bsgrub brgyud sras brgyud spel te/ /thar 'dod skye bo'i dbul ba bsal lo/ /khyad par phyi dar bstan pa'i gsal byed/ /kun gyi gtsug rgyan sa skya pa yis/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal srid bzung nas/ /gangs can chol kha gsum gyi 'gro ba/ /rnam grol thar pa'i lam la bkod de/ /byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir/ /rdzogs ldan bzhin du bde bas khyab bo/ /de rjes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen/ /'phel 'grib gnas skabs du ma shar yang / /dam pa'i skyes bu grangs med byon nas/ bstan pa'i me ro gso bar mdzad do/ /phyis dus bstan pa ha cang nyams tshe/ /sngags 'chang bla ma sprul pa'i skyes mchog /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen zhes grags/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal mgon de byon nas/ /dam pa de yi bstan pa'i ched du/ /sku srog nyid kyang gtong bar bzhed de/ /yid chad ngal dub khyad du bsad nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thabs mkhas du mas/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus te/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i/ /gtso mdzad dam pa snga mas bzhengs pa'i/ /gtsug lag khang chen nyams pa gsos shing / /gsar du bzhengs pa'ang bgrangs ba las 'das/ /khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa ba/ /grangs med dge 'dun 'du ba'i chos grwa/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung gsar du btsugs nas/ /skal bar ldan pa'i grangs med 'gro rnams/ /grub mtha' bzhi yi lam la khrid nas/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor bstan te/

/lung dang rig pa yun du bsgrub pa'i/ /man ngag zab mo'i bdud rtsi byin te/ /kun kyang thar pa'i lam la dkris nas/ /ljongs 'di rdzogs ldan bde la bkod do/ /mdor na dpyod ldan gzu bor gnas pas/ /skyes chen de yi ngo mtshar rnam thar/ /mdzad pa'i cha shas gang la bsam kyang / /mi phyed dad pas mchi ma lhung ngo / /de lta'i bstan pa'i nyi ma de nyid/ /nub rir yol nas da lta'i bar la/ /dbus gtsang bde ba'i go skabs bral nas/ /mi srid srid pa'i 'gyur ba shar te/ /bstan pa'i rgya mtsho skam la thug go /kye ma da ni mgon de'i sras mchog /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog de yang / /bdag cag 'gro ba'i bsod nams dman pas/ /kye hud zhing gzhan gshegs tshul bstan no/ /de phyir spyi dang bye brag bstan pa/ /lhag par gdan sa dpal ldan sa skya'i/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor phun tshogs/ /nag phyogs bdud sdes 'joms par nye'o/ /'di la kho bos lhag bsam dkar pos/ /kun nas blangs te dpal ldan sa skya'i/ /chos dang srid 'byor rgyas pa'i thabs la/ /dka' spyad du mas 'bad pa byas kyang / /kye ma bstan pa nyams su 'dod pas/ /chos mthun bsam don 'grub pa dka' ba/ /'di la bsam gyin mchi ma dku'o/ /bdag gis bstan pa snying nas bsam pa'i/ /rab tu dkar ba'i lhag bsam 'di la/ /rje btsun rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho la sogs/ /bslu med dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams/ /mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings nas gzigs la/ /yid la re ba'i bsam don thams cad/ /'bad med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /kye ma kyi hud sangs rgyas bstan pa/ /spyi dang bye brag 'jig la thug tshe/ /kho bo sngon bsags las kyis skyes pa'i/ /bstan pa nyams pa'i snang tshul mthong tshe/ /bzod med sdug bsngal drag pos gzir zhing / /deng sang bstan pa bsam pa'i skye bo/ /nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang dkon pa'i/ /blo ldan bdag gi mthun grogs nyung ba/

/'di la bsam gyin yang yang skyo 'o/ /dpyod ldan gzur gnas bstan pa bsam pa'i/ /dam pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig snang rung / /de dag mthun na bstan la phan dogs/ /dug chus myos pa'i ngan pa 'ga' yis/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis gnod pa skyel ba/ /'di la'ang bsam gyin skyo ba 'phel lo/ /lar rang dus ngan 'di 'dra'i skabs su/ /dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa 'di nyid/ /stong log spangs nas don ldan bya phyir/ /'dir snang bya ba lto gos gtam gsum/ /gang la'ang 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad nas/ /phyogs med rgyal khams ri khrod 'grims na/ /'di rang 'di phyi kun du legs sam/ /yengs med brjed med tur tur dran no/ /kho bo gzhon nu'i dus su'ang tshul 'di/ /snying nas 'dod kyang lag tu ma long / /phyi dus sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched du/ /ngal ba sna tshogs thog tu babs pa'i/ /kye ma dus ngan 'di 'dra shar tshe/ /su zhig dam chos snying nas mi 'dod/ /'dir snang skye bo rab 'bring thams cad/ /nges par 'chi zhing nam 'chi med pa'i/ /gnas tshul 'di la legs par bsam nas/ /chos med yud tsam dal ba'ang phod dam/ /kye hud deng sang skye bo 'di rnams/ /rang nyid gtan nas gtan du phung ba'i/ /mi dge bcu yi spyod tshab 'di dang / /gzhung tshig lung rig phyogs re shes la/ /chen por rlom pa'i rab 'byams 'di dang / /dbang khrid rgyud don dri ma bral yang / /cho ga'i khrigs tsam shes pa nyid la/ /sngags par 'dod pa'i snang shis 'di dang / /ngo tsha khrel med ngan spyod bgyid la/ /bzang por bgyid pa'i log lta 'di dang / /dpyod ldan gzur gnas chos mthun dag la/ /dkor nag dug chus myos pa'i mi yis/ /gzhi med skur 'debs mkhas lugs 'di dang / /lugs gnyis khrims 'gal spyod pa bgyid la/ /grol bar rlom pa'i grub thob 'di dang / /rgyun du bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kho nas/ /rang gzhan gnyis phung las la sbyor yang / /chos par rlom pa'i rlom sems 'di dang /

/rang nyid nam 'chi gar skye med kyang / /gzhan gyis yar 'dren byed rang zer ba'i/ /bdag 'dra'i bla ma'i mang lugs 'di sogs/ /kye ma snang tshul gang la bsam kyang / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa lnga brgya tha ma'i/ /rtag tsam 'dzin pa sleb pa 'dra'o/ /'on kyang skal ldan kho bo cag ni/ /sa bcu'i byang sems bud+dha rat+na'i/ /rnam 'phrul sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bo/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa rin chen mnga' bdag /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen chen po/ /yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan bla ma/ /rgyal ba mus pa rje dang mjal bas/ /gtan du legs pa'i 'dun ma tshugs so/ /bka' drin mnyam med mgon po khyod las/ /gzhan pa'i skyabs mgon bdag la med pas/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med zungs la/ /rtag tu don gnyis mthar phyin mdzod cig /ces pa 'di ni snyigs dus dus ngan gyi snang tshul la skyo shas drag po skyes pa'i rkyen byas/ /sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bsam rtse brang chen du smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs dkon mchog thugs rje nyid/ /nye bar bskul ba'i yi ge bzhugs/159 rje bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /sprang nyes med sdug bsngal kyi gzir ba 'di/ /thugs phod pa 'dug gam spyan gyis gzigs/ /spyir deng sang bstan pa'i nyams lugs sam/ /sgos 'khrul med rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan dri med 'di yi 'jig lugs la/ /legs bsam na snying rlung ldang la khad/ /tshul 'di nyid bdag gi ma bzod pas/ /bstan phyir du dka' ba mang spyad kyang / /de dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /yid bsam pa bzhin du mi 'grub pa/ /'di bsam pas yid chad mchi ma dku/ /khong sangs rgyas bstan pa mi bsam pa'i/ /blo rang don phur tshugs bsgrub pa rnams/ /don gzur gnas khrel ba'i las kho na/ /dus yang yang spyad kyang rgyal kha lon/

/'di tshe 'di rgyal kyang phyi ma phung / /don las 'bras bslu med yin phyir ro/ /rje gong mas btsugs pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /mi bdag gi snying nas spel 'dod kyang / /khong rjes 'jug gzhan gyis bshig lugs 'di/ /khyed bstan srung rgya mtshos gzigs re ran/ /rje sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun rin gyis/ /bka' dran par mdzod cig dam can rnams/ /bdag 'khon rigs dge slong a nan+da/ /lo gzhon nu nyid nas lhag bsam dkar/ /dus da lta bstan la gcig tu dad/ /'di bslu med rgya mtsho'i thugs la gsal/ /rgyu des na mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rnams/ /thugs brtse bas dmag dpung rab bskyed la/ /bstan rin chen bshig pa'i log bsgrub kun/ /dus da lta nyid du zhi bar mdzod/ /thugs ma g.yel ma g.yel dkon mchog tshogs/ /dus deng sang mi dge spyod rnams rgyal/ /bstan bsam pa'i skye bo pham dus 'dir/ /khyed dkon mchog mkhyen brtse nus ldan tshos/ /rtags mtshan ma mngon sum ma bstan na/ /dus 'di la bstan pa su yi 'dzin/ /bdag ming btags rnams kyi re thag chad/ /rgyu des na bslu med dkon mchog rnams/ /yun ma ring ma ring rtags mtshan phyung / /mi bdag gis bsam don mthar phyin nas/ /bstan dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni sa bcu'i byang sems bud+dha rat+na'i rnam par sprul pa deng sang gangs can gyi khrod kyi 'dren mdzad kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gyur pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la yan lag mchog gi reg pa shrī sa skya pa byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos me mo sbrul lo chu stod zla ba'i nyer brgyad kyi nyin bsam rtse brang chen yang thog tu snyigs dus kyi snang tshul las yid 'byung drag po bzod glags med pa'i ngang nas bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //snying gtam bzod pa gong 'phel bzhugs/160

na mo gu ru/ pha bla ma rje btsun chos kyi rje/ /yongs thugs rje'i skyong mdzad kun snying dang / /chos kun mkhyen bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs/ /rje rdo rje 'dzin pa grags pa'i mtshan/ /bstan phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad lo tsā ba/ /kun mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur 'phags pa sogs/ /rje mtshungs bral rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs brtse bas rtag tu skyong du gsol/ /bdag gis skye ba snga ma la/ /dge ba cung zad spyad pa'i mthus/ /'bras bu tshe 'dir legs par smin/ /rigs kyi nang nas lha yi rigs/ /khyad par 'khon gyi brgyud du skyes/ /chos dang mi chos rnam gnyis las/ /'jig rten bzhag nas chos sgor zhugs/ /gang nas bltas kyang nyams re dga'/ /ci nas bsam yang blo re bde/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la/ /snying nas dad pa yod pas bde/ /kha yi mos pa spangs pas bde/ /lus chas ngan pa bzhag pas bde/ /thub pas na bza' mdzes pas bde/ /gnyis med bya ba bshol bas bde/ /gnyis ldan bya ba bsgrub pas bde/ /bdud mos 'then thag med pas bde/ /bu dang bu mo med pas bde/ /bla ma la dad pa yod pa 'di/ /'di phyi gnyis kyi skyabs gnas yin/ /sngags pa'i lus chas bzhag pa 'di/ /'gro kun dad pa bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /ngur smrig lus la gyon pa 'di/ /bstan la bya ba byed pa'i rtags/ /gnyis med bya ba dor ba 'di/ /'di phyi bde ba'i rgyu gcig yin/ /bud med kyi grogs po med pa 'di/ /'khor ba'i 'then thag chad pa'i rtags/ /bu dang bu mo med pa 'di/ /gang la'ang zhen chags med pa'i rgyu/ /rnal 'byor ngag dbang kun bsod ngas/ /gang snang bde skyid snang bar shar/ /'on kyang dus ngan snyigs pas na/ /spun dang mdza' bshes nye du mang / /blo thub skye bo shin tu dkon/ /kye ma snyigs ma'i dus 'di la/ /spun ngan mdza' bshes nye du sogs/ /ngan pa'i kha nas 'di skad lo/ /khyod kyi bstan bshig dam tshig nyams/ /mdor na mi min bong bu yin/

/zhes sogs gnod med don med par/ /snying la mda' zug 'dra ba yi/ tshig rtsub gal te smras byung tshe/ /pha rol skye bas bzhin ras la/ /bltas te bsam pa 'di ltar bskyed/ /las 'bras ma go snying re rje/ /snyam du yang yang bsgom par bya/ /de nas bstan bshig bya ba'i tshig /de la sems nyid legs gtad de/ /bstan bshig bya ba'i tshig 'bru 'di/ /sngon tshe gang byung da gar 'gro/ /da lta gang na gnas bltas pas/ /gang du'ang ma grub de bzhin can/ des na bden med ngang la bzhag /tshig 'bru gzhan la'ang don 'di mtshungs/ /de la gnad du bsnun pa na/ bden med rtogs pa'ang srid pa yod/ /'on kyang zhi gnas lhag mthong sbyongs/ /de ltar dus ngan snyigs ma yis/ /mi ngan spyod ngan byed pa la/ /gnyen po bsten par bya ba yis/ /snying gtam tshigs su bcad pa 'di/ /'khon gyi rigs skyes sa skya pa/ /btsun pa ngag dbang kun bsod kyis/ /snyigs ma'i dus su rab mkho ba'i/ /bzod pa bsgom pa'i gdams pa 'di/ /rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi /mkha' spyod gnas su myur bar bris/ /'di brtsams dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i bar chad rnams/ /zhi zhing myur du 'grub pa yis/ /bkra shis bdag la stsal du gsol/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams shar yi ger bris pa dge legs 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/161 na mo gu ru puṇ+ya in+d+ra ye/ grub pa'i sar bzhugs rje btsun chos kyi rje/ /'di phyi bde ba'i dpal ster bka' drin can/ /phun tshogs 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor bu la/ /dad pa'i mtsho las bstod dbyangs pad mtsho rgyas/ /de ltar mchod par brjod nas bshad bya'i don/ /skal ldan mtshan nyid rtags dang myos byed kyi/ /nyes dmigs brjod dang grub thob gang zag rnams/ /brtag byed 'di ni legs par bshad kyi nyon/ /skal ldan mkhas pas gang smras nges shes shing / /cal col chang bzang ja bral nyos pas lags/

/tab tob the tshom dang bral nem med 'gyur/ /dpa' bo pham byed ba glang ma 'dren zhing / /rtsub chen tsha grangs dzam bsnun wa mi 'gyur/ /zha long za btung 'phrog cing la 'ur yin/ /ral 'chang la dar sha za sa thob 'gyur/ ha dang a yi sgra chen khams gsum 'gengs/ /yi ge rtsa ba yig 'bru sum cu las/ dang po ka sde'i skal ldan mtshan nyid bstan/ /ca sde'i chang gi nyes dmigs bstan byas nas/ /ta sde nas bzung a yi bar dag gi /grub thob gang zag brtag pa bstan zin to/ /nad gdon smyo 'bog dag dang ma nor gces/ /de bzhin shes ldan rnams kyis rtogs par mdzod/ /nyin mo'i skar 'dra'i bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib ni/ /bstan pa'i bdag po rnams la rag las mod/ /'on kyang bdud sprul rnams kyis phan tshun kun/ /dkrugs pa 'di la bdag cag sems skyo 'o/ /'jig rten ltar snang bu skyes ma la byams/ /bu skyes ma ngor bu yi chung ma la/ /pha yis sems pa rnams kyang 'os min 'gyur/ /skyes chen dam pa rnams ni tshul ston yin/ /gang zag 'jig rten rnams kyis go bar mdzod/ /deng sang 'jig rten 'di na dpe srol la/ /bu skyes gnam mthong snga bas pha sa 'dzin/ /de nyid dor te chung la re ba 'di/ /babs par 'gyur ba gzur gnas rnams kyi dpyod/ /deng sang skye bo che 'bring chung gsum rnams/ /dkon mchog dpang btsugs bya ba spyod pa dkon/ /don la bza' 'dod yin pa rnam pa ni/ /phyogs 'dzin yin zhes gtam ngan smra 'di skyo/ /don gyi chos bzhin byed pa shin tu dkon/ /gal te byed pa la la dpon gyis dgag /kha cig 'khor gyis dgag cing don bsdu na/ /chos kyi mthun rkyen nyung ba 'di skyo 'o/ /don la tshig gcig go don ma rtogs kyang / /nga rgyal zhe sdang gnod sems rgyud gang nas/ /chos rjes gsungs pa'i bstan bcos 'ga' zhig la/ /skyon tshogs brjod pa 'di 'dra snang ba 'khrul/ /rje btsun gong ma'i bstan pa mi 'dzin na'ang /

/skyon tshogs brjod pa 'di 'dra snang ba 'khrul/ /rje btsun gong ma'i bstan pa mi 'dzin na'ang / /khyed shes zhabs 'dren 'di 'dra mi mdzad 'tshal/ /bdag cag snying nas bstan pa 'dzin 'dod pas/ /dkon mchog rnams kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /don 'di myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /deng sang skye bo ngan pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /spyod ngan bgyis pas bstan pa shugs kyis nub/ /mun khung 'dra bar bstan pa dri med kyis/ /sgron me chen po bdag gis gsal bar shog /'chi ba mi rtag nges 'byung rab skyes nas/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang ste/ /gsal stong zug 'jug chos la 'bad byas nas/ /tshe 'dir snying po long pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni grub pa'i sa brnyes 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs la spyi bos reg cing snying nas dad pa thob pa'i 'khon rigs shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod gnas su rang lo bcu drug gi thog tu bris pa yin/ 'di bgyis dge bas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos thugs kyi byin rlabs bdag gi rgyud la 'byor bar gyur cig /dge'o/ /dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis sngar byung gi tshul rnams smras pa yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs/162 rje rdo rje 'chang dngos mi yi gzugs 'chang / /snying po rtse mo rgyal mtshan zhabs dang / /thub dbang gnyis pa chos rje khu dbon/ /khyed rnams yab sras brgyud par bcas la/ /snying nas dad pas gsol ba 'debs so/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos rje/ /gang gi thugs sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched/ /rigs kun khyab bdag mus pa chen po/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la btud nas/ /de 'dra'i yongs 'dzin bslu med rnams la/ /bstan pa'i rjes zhugs nyams chung bdag gis/ /sngar byung rnam thar mdo tsam brjod na/

/kho bo sngon tshe gzhon nu'i dus su/ /tshe sngon las 'phro cung zad sad pas/ /chos mthun rtse 'jo kho nas 'da' zhing / /kha lta mngon shes 'dra ba'ang 'ong nyung / /cung zad skyes nas rab byung 'dod cing / /gzhung lugs phyogs med sbyongs par 'dod cing / /'dun pa drag po ngam ngam ngang nas/ /mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms yun ring lus so/ /de 'dra'i skabs su gzhan rkyen 'dra yis/ /gong bzhugs rnams kyang thugs mthun med cing / /phan med gnyen 'dras nyes med kho bo'i/ /yang yang sems rgyud dkrug te skyo 'o/ /de tshe 'jam dbyangs sku mched drung du/ /rdo rje phur pa kye rdor yab yum/ /gsang 'dus mi bskyod sogs kyi dbang dang / /rjes gnang bka' gtad lung gi tshogs mang / /lam 'bras lung ma khrid la sogs pa/ /dam chos bka' drin 'ga' zhig nos so/ /skabs cig 'jam dbyangs puṇ+ya in+d+ras/ /thugs rje'i drin las rab tu byung yang / /dam pa phan tshun thugs kyi bzhed pa/ /cung zad mthun par ma gyur dbang gis/ /bdag ni tsher phung dbus su lus ltar/ /ji ltar byas kyang stabs ma bde ba'i/ /tshul rnams dran tshe da dung skyo 'o/ /'di sogs nges 'byung du ma'i rkyen dang / /lhag par ma gcig bsod nams rgyal mo/ /glo bur gshegs pa'i rkyen gyis bskul nas/ /sngar nas rje btsun mus pa'i rnam thar/ /thos nas mjal 'dod bcos min yod pa/ /me 'bar shing bsnan lta bur gyur to/ /de tshe dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mgon des/ /kho bo thugs rje'i lcags kyus bkug nas/ /yun ring ma lon zhabs drung sleb te/ /mjal ma thag nas thugs yid gcig 'dres/ /thog mar sdom gsum bka' drin stsal zhing / /de nas sa skya pa yi yab chos/ /bde kye gsang gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i/ /dbang khrid lung dang man ngag rgya mtsho/ /rjes gnang bka' gtad phyag len phra mo/ /tshun chad bum pa gang byo stsal nas/ /'di phyir legs pa'i 'dun ma tshugs shing /

/mgon de sangs rgyas dngos su thag chod/ /deng dus yongs 'dzin nga bzang rnams kyi/ /rnam thar kun la 'gram chu ma ldang / /mkhas grub gtsug rgyan de dang mjal bas/ /a la la ho blo bde phugs tshud/ /dus der gong bzhugs dgongs pa bkrol nas/ /dben par thos bsam byed blo bgyis kyang / /dge ba'i bshes dang blo ldan grogs sogs/ /kye ma mthun rkyen gang yang med pas/ yid chad ngang la yun ring thal lo/ de tshe sngags 'chang grags pa'i gsung gis/ dpal ldan sa skya'i sde dang bstan pa/ gdung brgyud bcas 'di chags sam 'jig la/ /thug pa'i dus la babs tshe khyod kyis/ /bstan pa'i khur 'di nges par long zhes/ /yang yang stsal yang thabs mkhas du mas/ /thugs dgongs bkrol bas re zhig 'gyangs so/ /da ni ma 'ongs lung bstan 'di 'dra/ /thog tu babs tshe snying nas dad do/ /rang gi bsam pa snga phyi kun du/ /mtho dman bar gsum gang gi sar yang / /bsam sbyor ngan pa gang yang med mod/ /'on kyang rang gi sngon bsags las kyi/ /'phen byed rdzogs byed 'ga' yi rgyu las/ /grub dbang rnams la 'khrul pa ci mnga'/ /bdud sprul 'ga' yi thabs 'phrul du mas/ /nged rang sa skya'i gdung brgyud sku mched/ /zlos gzhi med pa'i gzings bshig byas nas/ /kho bo'i las su dam chos byas kyang / /don med dkon mchog dgra ldang dpe bzhin/ /mi bden pa rnams gcig tu byas nas/ /bden pa khyad gsod kho na'i dbang gis/ /mi srid srid pa'i 'gyur ba de 'dra/ /kye hud dus der shar bar gyur te/ /de tshe mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa'i/ /bslu med dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang / /gzur gnas sa skyong mi dbang rnams sogs/ /blo ldan phal cher bdag la 'dun mod/ /'on kyang dus ngan skye bo'i mtshan nyid/ /tshangs ba'i ngan rnams mgrin gcig bsgrigs nas/ /ri bong cal bzhin grags pa'i rjes 'brangs/ /sngar 'dris 'ga' zhig btang snyoms bzhugs shing /

/la la thabs mkhas gzur zhing 'gros la/ /kha cig gzhi med skur 'debs byed pas/ /dus der rnal 'byor sprang po bdag la/ /ngo shes pa dang gnam las ma byung / /de rjes re zhig dben par bsdad tshe/ /dkor gyi myos pa'i ngan pa'i 'khor 'dras/ /bag med spyod pas shes rgyud dkrugs tshe/ /ngag 'jam sems bzang blo gros gsal ba'i/ /grogs mchog gang gis yang yang sems gsos/ /'di 'dra bsam gyin spro ba 'phel lo/ /de tshe skal ngan bdag la brten nas/ /sdug bsngal khang bur zhugs pa dag la/ /gsang khog nang nas phan cha bsgrub pa/ /tshul 'di'ang gang nas dka' ba byung ngo / /'on kyang de nas yun ring min par/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho yi/ /rnam sprul sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan dang / /rdo rje 'chang dngos mus pa chen po'i/ /lung bstan ji bzhin thog tu babs nas/ /pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul bsod nams dbang pos/ /rang gi sngon bsags las ngan tshogs rnams/ /de tsam yan gyi dag par dgongs nas/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis rjes su bzung ste/ /lugs gnyis bka' drin chen pos bskyangs so/ /de tshe rang gi sngar byas las rnams/ /'gyod sems drag pos bshags par bgyis nas/ /zab chos thugs kyinying khu nos pas/ /rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig gyur nas/ /dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba thams cad/ /rang gi ngang gis dbang du 'dus shing / /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ /gang nas bltas kyang dga' dga' 'dra bas/ /ngo mtshar tshul 'di kho bo'i rnam thar/ /'di bzhin 'byung ba'ang bla ma'i bka' drin/ /kho nar nges pas gsol ba 'debs so/ /da dung bsam pa mthar phyin mdzod cig /de ltar rang nyid dpal 'byor thob nas/ /gnod byed rnams kyang brtse bas bskyangs shing / /phan byed rnams la'ang yang dag phan pa/ /bsgrub par bya zhes gsung rab las bshad/ /de bzhin bdag gis dgra gnyen so sor/ /'khos dang bstun pa'i phan pa yang dag

/bsgrub pa yin mod dus ngan mi rnams/ /rang nyid sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying las/ /gzhan rnams cung zad bde la mi bzod/ /de phyir bsam pa tshim pa dka' 'o/ /las rang sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung las/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'di dang 'di ni bdag gi dgra ste/ /'di dang 'di ni bdag gi gnyen zhes/ /so sor 'byed pa rmongs pa'i lugs yin/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis khyad par med par/ /bskyangs pas skabs 'gar gnyen pas dgra nyid/ /phan par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa 'di la/ /kho bo nges shes lhag par skyes so/ /rgyal po la sogs chen po rnams la/ /dgra bas rang gi 'khor ngan rnams kyi/ /gnod pa'i tshul lugs shin tu mang ste/ /g.yon can 'ga' yi rgyal sa'ang 'phrog cing / /'ga' zhig dpon 'di blun zhes smod la/ /la la ha cang rtsub zhes skur 'debs/ /kha cig byas med yus kyi nga rgyal/ /mdor na dpon gyi mdzad 'phrin cha shas/ /gang la'ang 'khor gyi skyon 'dogs med pa'i/ /gnas skabs 'ga' yang yod pa ma mthong / /de phyir 'khor gyi tshig ngan mtshon gyis/ /dpon gyi thugs yid dum bur gtub pa'i/ /kye hud snyigs ma'i snang tshul 'di mtshar/ /bdag la'ang cung zad nyams dma'i dus su/ /bza' btung byed la lhan cig tshogs pa'i/ /'khor ngan 'dra yis deng sang dus na/ /bdag gi drin las rang gi lto gos/ /thams cad 'byongs pa'i bsam mno mi gtong / /phan gdags gang gis kyang tshim rgyu med/ /sngon dus zhabs tog chen po byas zhes/ /'khang pa'i tshig ngan kha sbyor smra ba'i/ /tshod med rnams la snying nas khrel lo/ /'on kyang skal bzang rnal 'byor kho bos/ /bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs chen bgyis tshe/ /skye ngan spyod pas lus sems dub kyang / /skyo sun med par ngang gis bskyangs pas/ /sngar yang bstan la phan pa byung zhing / /da dung bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis/ /bsam pa thams cad mtha' ru phyin nas/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa rin chen/

/dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas te/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub tshe/ /dpon slob 'bral med dag pa'i zhing mchog /bde ba can du thogs med skye bar/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /gcig chog rgyal pos byin gyis rlobs shig /dus gsum gzigs pas byin gyis rlobs shig /'brel tshad don ldan byin gyis rlobs shig /mthong ba don ldan byin gyis rlobs shig /dang ba 'dren pas byin gyis rlobs shig /skyabs gnas kun 'dus byin gyis rlobs shig /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa sh+yakya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi slob bu 'ga' zhig gi don du bzhi thog bla brang tshom dmar du bris pa 'dis dge legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig /yi ge pa ni shab stod pa maṅgala'i ming can no/ /sarba dā oṃ/ sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs/163 na mo gu ru tri ṇi me/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba gcig chog rgyal po rang rig bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / gang thugs ye shes ro gcig pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po la/ sdig bshags gsol 'debs byinagyis rlobs/ byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho/ /snyigs dus slar yang mi yi zol/ /sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la/ /sdig bshags gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'phags pa rin chen rje'i/ /rnam 'phrul da lta mkha' spyod bzhugs/ /khyab bdag sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ /sdig bshags gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems dag pa'i lta shes na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /'brel tshad don ldan bka' drin can/

/bla ma rnams gsum bdag la dgongs/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /mthu rtsal bskyed cig bsod nams dbang / /byang sems stsol zhig grags pa'i mtshan/ /lam snang drongs shig mus pa rje/ /kun gyi don gnyis lhun grub mdzod/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan khyed gsum gyis/ /bdag la brtse bas ma bskyangs na/ /gtan du dug gsum la spyod pa'i/ /las ngan can bdag su la re/ /gzhan yang bdag la ltos bcas sogs/ /dgra gnyen bar ma 'di kun kyang / /khyed rnams thugs rjes bdag cag dang / /lhan cig bde ba can bgrod shog /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /dus 'dir bsam pa mthar phyin zhing / /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing skyes nas/ /sprul pas bstan pa rgyas byas te/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa 'di/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i sku ring bzhin/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs khyab gyur cig /ces rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di ni sa skya pa za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams gsum dran pa'i mod la gdung dbyangs kyi tshul gyis gsol ba btab pa 'dis kyang 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs bdud rtsi'i thig phreng yid bde'i dpal ster bzhugs/164 oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rje lha mchog zur phud lnga pa dang / /khong stobs kyi mgon po bi ru pa'i/ /don brgyud pa 'dzin par rjes bzung ba'i/ /dpal sa skya'i bla chen yab sras sogs/ /skyabs kun 'dus bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /tshe 'di phyi bar dor thugs rjes gzigs/ /dus 'du 'bral med par skyabs su gsol/ /mi chos 'byor bral ba'i sprang po ngas/ /blo bsam mno 'chos pa'i glu chung 'di/ /tshig sgrigs legs spangs te thol byung smras/

/nga mthun rkyen 'dzoms na 'dzoms ste dga'/ /mi kho bo la mthun rkyen ci byung yang / /ljongs bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /bstan bstan 'dzin dgon gnas bcas pa yis/ /don zhabs tog kho na las gzhan gang / /yang mthun rkyen zhan na zhan pas dga'/ /'du 'dzi chung bas g.yeng ba chung / /g.yengs ba chung bas chos spyod 'phel/ /dpal 'byor che yi sdug bsngal che/ /kun kyang mi rtag 'jig chos can/ /nga mi tshe ring na ring bas dga'/ /rang gi lus ngag 'di gsum gyis/ /spyod lam bya ba che phra kun/ /bstan 'gro yi don las ma 'das shing / /rang dang nyer gnas kyi grogs kun kyang / /rtag tu chos mthun gyi las spyad nas/ /rang gzhan kun gtan legs kyi 'dun ma byas/ /mdun ma de gegs med 'grub ste mchis/ /mi kho bo'i nyer gnas rnams skal ba bzang / /yang 'chi bar gyur kyang 'gyod pa med/ /bstan 'gro la phan 'dod kyi lhag bsam dang bcas/ /sngar byas kyi sdig pa kun bshags shing / /'dir snang gi bya ba gnang med pa'o/ /ci byas sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba la/ /don med kyi 'khri ba kun bcad de/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog la blo gtad nas/ /'pho ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyar te/ /zhing bde ba can du skye bar smon/ /gnas mchog der bu slob gdul bya sogs/ /'gro ba kun rim bzhin 'dren par re/ /ci byas kyang bde ba'i blo gdengs 'di/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /pha mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin las thob/ /sngon byon gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /khong la la sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /bhu su ku'i tshul gyis bstan pa skyong / /kha cig ni smyon spyod tho co mkhan/ /'ar 'ur dang ngan cal col tshul/ /la la dag thos bsam sgom gsum dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi bstan pa spel/ /de kun kyang sangs rgyas su ro gcig kyang / /'phral gdul bya'i las snang tha dad pas/ /khong 'dul byed sku yang de der snang /

/de dus kyi dus mtshungs slob ma rnams/ /dad cing gus pa rnams kun kyang grol/ /dad pa med rnams da dung lus/ /dpe 'di 'dra dngos su mthong bzhin du/ /khong dad med rnams snying re rje ba la/ /mi kho bo la bla ma mang yod cing / /khong de kun yang gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /'dul byed kyi rnam pa tha dad kyang / /don yin lugs rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /thugs ye shes ngang du ro gcig bzhugs/ /tshul 'di la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ /chos kun kyang yid bde'i blta mor shar/ /gnad 'di 'dra shes tshad rang tshangs yin/ /'di ma shes kun kyang rang phung yin/ /don zab mo 'di 'dra rtogs pa yang / /rje bla ma kho na'i thugs rje ste/ /khyed rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /drin dus gsum sangs rgyas yongs las lhag /thugs mkhyen brtse nus pa kun ldan pa/ /bu yid gnyis med par gsol 'debs kyi/ /sngar bzhin du bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /yid bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ /nga chos med rnal 'byor an+das/ /chos nyams len til tsam mi 'dug kyang / /rje yongs 'dzin bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /rang bsam pa'i khyer so 'di bzhin yod/ /gzhi gzhi med rtsa bral gnas lugs 'di/ /rje rje btsun bla ma'i thugs kyi shigs/ /sems sems de dang dbyer med pa/ /bu bu slob yid kyang de yi ngang / /ngang de nas mthong thos rig gsum 'di/ /'di bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su bsgom/ /bsgom de 'dra'i ngang nas rnam g.yengs kun/ /bstan 'gro'i don du gyur cig snyam/ /yid lhag bsam mtha' ru phyin pa dang / /dus phyi ma mthong thos dran reg kun/ /zhing bde ba can du kun bgrod par/ /snying thag pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam bgyis/ /yang nyams len snying po'i byed lugs 'di/ /rang skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / /rje bla ma kho na mkhyen snyam pa'i/ /yid kha zhe med pa'i gsol 'debs byas/ /sngar yan kyang 'di bzhin spyad pa legs/

/dus da dung 'di gas don kun 'grub/ /gzhan zab zab chos kyi che ba yin/ /bu dad ldan rnams kyis dgongs par mdzod/ /ces nyams dbyangs bdud rtsi'i thig phreng yid bde'i dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di yang rnal 'byor gdod mar grol ba'i 'brug lo sa ga zla ba'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub pa brnyes pa'i dus bzang tshes nyer gsum nas gnam gang gi bar la dpal sa skya'i lha chen rigs 'dzin pho brang du dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu chig bsgrub bgyis pa'i dus zhig gi tshe/ rang la spangs rtogs kyi yon tan gang yang med pa'i snang tshul rnams bsam na/ dam rdzas bsgrub pa 'dis mtshon nas deng sang gi gzhan don mdzad pa'i bla ma rang dang 'dra ba rnams kyis dbang khrid lung man ngag ston pa sogs bla ma gong ma'i mdzad 'phrin skyong ba'i lugs 'di rnams phal cher/ mi'i lad mo spre'us byed pa dang mtshungs par 'dug snyam rang nyid la zhe khrel dang / /bla ma gong ma spyi dang / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams gdul bya'i snang ngor 'byon pa snga phyi tsam ma gtogs don la sangs rgyas dngos su ro gcig pa'i nges shes khyad par can rnyed nas/ dpal sa skya pa za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor la rtag 'grus su bgyid pa'i sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dam rdzas bsgrub pa'i thun mtshams su nyams la gang shar tshig bsgrigs ma byas par thol byung du bris pa 'dis bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin 'bad med du 'grub par gyur cig smras pa/ bla ma rnams dang dbyer med pa'i/ /stobs kyi mgon po bi ru pa/ /khyod la snying nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /'di yang gong gi rtsom pa po nyid kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i phyir bgyis pa lags/ /sarba dā oṃ/ ka l+ya na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //'bras bu rtsis kyi gsal byed yin/165 'bras rtsis kyi gsal byed ni/ khyim rnams kyi yun ci tsam thub ni/

lug nas nya'i bar gyi khyim re res zhag sum cu re thub cing lo tho'i nang du lug khyim rdzogs nas glang la zin pa yin la/ rgyu mtshan des na lug khyim zin pa nas/ nya khyim rdzogs zer ba lo thor 'byung ba de dang / 'bras rtsis kyi dpe la bltas pas shes so/ /rten 'brel ni smal po'i bcu drug nas rgyal zla'i bcu drug bar ma rig pa/ de bzhin du 'du byed rnam shes/ ming gzugs/ skye mched/ reg pa/ tshor ba/ sred pa/ len pa/ srid pa/ skye ba/ rga shi ste bcu gnyis po la/ tshes bcu drug nas mgo bzung ba'i zla ba re re thub pas/ dper na rgyal zla'i bcu drug nas/ mchu zla ba'i bco lnga'i bar 'du byed de bzhin du smin drug gi bcu drug nas mgo zla ba'i bcu drug bar gyis rten 'brel dga' bzhi rdzogs pa yin pas de ltar du shes par bya'o/ /lo tho'i skar ma'i aṃ gi'i 'og gi chu tshod 'das grangs yin la/ de 'phros longs spyod rgyu yin pas nyin zhag phrugs gcig la chu tshod drug cu'i dbang du byas pa'i dper na skar ma dbyug pa'i 'og na chu tshod sum cu yod na de 'das grub pa yin la/ nam langs nas brtsams te dbyug pas sum cu las mi thub pas/ de nas bra nye la zin rgyu yin/ skar ma'i chu tshad 'das grangs rnams nam langs phan yin zhing / de 'phros nam zang na spyod rgyu yin/ nyi ma re la dus sbyor ram khyim bcu gnyis rtsi na/ dper na lug khyim gyi skabs su/ nam langs chu tshod lnga la lug nyi shar chu tshod lnga la glang / /nyi dros lnga la 'khrig pa/ nyi phyed lnga karka ṭa/ phyed yol lnga la seng ge dgong phyed lnga la bu mo/ nyi rgas lnga la srang / /sa sros lnga la sdig pa/ srod chen lnga la gzhu/ nam phyed lnga la chu srin/ phyed yol lnga la bum pa/ tho rangs nyal la lnga yin zhing / /de bzhin nya khyim skabs su nam langs nya nas 'dzin/ nyi ma bcu gnyis sam lo skor bcu gnyis/ zhag re la re re dang zhag gcig bcu gnyis po kun sbyor lugs ni/

nag pa zla ba'i tshes gcig stag gi nyi ma nas brtsams te gnam gang la lug gi nyi ma dang / sa ga'i tshes gcig spre'u'i nyi ma sogs rim pas rtsi/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la lo skor bcu gnyis rtsi na/ nam langs yos nas/ tho rangs stag gi bar dus dang lo rta sbyor rgyu yin no/ /zhes pa 'di yang rnal 'byor gdod nas rang grol gyis sug bris bgyis pa'o// ༈ //rang lo nyer gsum lon skabs nyin zhag phrug re'i dge sbyor nyams len gyi rim pa rnams dang 'phral gyi kun spyod rnams chos dang mthun par spyod pa'i tshul dran gso gsal 'debs kyi yi ge bzhugs/166 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag he ru ka /zhing 'dir ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /sdom gsum bka' drin stsol ba'i drin can rje/ /rgyal ba mus pa chen po rtag tu rgyal/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rang lo nyer gsum lon skabs nyin zhag phrug re'i dge sbyor nyams len gyi rim pa rnams dang / 'phral gyi kun spyod rnams kyang chos dang mthun par spyad pa'i tshul sogs dran gso gsal 'debs su yi ger bkod pa ni 'di ltar te/ 'o skol rnams dal 'byor gyi mi lus lan cig thob pa'i dus 'dir mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i lam dri ma med pa nyams su blangs rgyu yod pa 'di ni skal ba bzang ba las kyang ches mchog tu bzang ba yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyams len thams cad bsdu na sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len du 'du zhing / de las yang so thar/ byang sems/ rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa dang gsum las/ so thar la nang gses gyi dbye ba mang du yod kyang bsdu na dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa dang gsum du 'dus pa yin zhing /

/de rnams skyon med pa'i mkhan po mtshan ldan las legs par thob pa tshul bzhin du srung sdom bgyid pa la gus sbyor mi dman yang / bslab bya phra mo tshun tshul bzhin du srung sdom dka' bar 'dug mod/ 'on kyang phyi'i kun spyod 'dul ba dang mthun dgos par gsungs pa ltar yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du chos gos lhung bzed/ chab gsum 'bral med du bgyid pa dang / snga dro gung tshigs ma yol ba dang / dgong spangs ba sogs bstan pa'i mig rgyan la gang phan dang / lhag par rtsa ba chang dang lnga po 'di la ngo lkog med pa'i srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyid cing / byang sems kyi sdom pa brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi cho ga sogs la brten nas thob pa mi nyams pa'i phyir/ de'i sdom pa'i snying po smon 'jug gi bsdus pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyi chos mthun gyi bya ba che phra kun la rtsis gang zin byas shing / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa phar phyin drug dang / bsdu ba dngos gzhi sogs la yang ci nus su slob la/ rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa rgyud sde tha dad gyi dbang chog so so las thob tshul mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs kyang / kun gyi yang rtse rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa'i snying po bskyed rdzogs kyi sdom pa yin zhing / de dag rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las tshul bzhin du thob pa mi mnyam pa'i phyir rdo rje theg pa gtso bor ston pa'i lam dri ma med pa rnams nyams su len tshul ni/ thog mar tho rangs gi cha la babs pa na nyams len gyi gtso bo ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis lang nas rong ston chen po nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig gzungs thung sum brgya/ gzungs ring nyer gcig rlung sbyor nyer gcig gam /bdun re dang bcas pa/ de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi srung ba thun mong ba la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig

aṅgu li bco lnga/ de nas lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig rje bla ma'i sku bstod gsol 'debs brgya rtsa res/ de nas dkar cha bzhi dang / dbyug gu ma la chang bu phul rjes/ kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa lam dus kyi dbang rgyas par blangs ba dang / dbang bzhi'i mtshams su brda chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len dang bcas pa la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yig brgya nyer gcig uṣ+ṇi kha nyer gcig rdzogs rim gyi skabs su rlung sbyor gyi rgyal po srog rtsol rdo rje'i bzlas pa stong rtsa re'am lnga brgya re/ gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa lan bdun/ aṣ+ṭa so gcig de nas 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu pa lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yig brgya nyer gcig rdzogs rim rim lnga rim pa gang rung re lan lnga re/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags rnams brgya rtsa re dang / 'khor gyi sngags nyer gcig re/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len rje dam pa'i gsung rgyun zab mo du mas brgyan pa la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yig brgya nyer gcig oṃ gsum ma brgya/ yid bzlas rlung sbyor bdun re/ chig brgyud kyi 'pho ba la nan tan dang bcas pa/ de nas phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi sgom bzlas la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sngags thung brgya/ sngags ring nyer gcig de nas gur gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya ka ya sogs so gcig yi ge bdun ma dang bcu gnyis ma brgya rtsa re re/ shā sa na so gcig de nas bla ma rin 'byung la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig maṇ+ḍal bdun ma tshar drug dang / so bdun ma gcig phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal tshar re re/ de nas zhal bzhi pa'i tshe sgrub srung 'khor gur bdun ma la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yi dam kyi sngags dang gur mgon gyi yi ge bdun ma/

dpal mgon rang gi gzungs thung rnams brgya rtsa re re/ dpal mgon gyi gzungs ring so gcig oṃ āḥyur+dzñā na sogs nyer gcig srung ba dang zlog pa'i sngags brgya rtsa re re/ rlung sbyor bdun re/ de nas nged rang la blo gtad bcol ba'i gshin po rnams kyi don du dmigs pa'i smon lam gyi rim pa la/ thog mar skyabs 'gro nyer gcig de nas tshad med bzhi dang / nged rang sku mched gsum gyi yum lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo zhing brjes dus nged rang gis brtsams pa'i smon lam rgyas pa tshar gcig dang / bsdus pa bcu gcig ngan song sdug bsngal sogs dang / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs lan nyer gcig bkra shis kyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa/ de nas seng gdong sngon mo'i sgom bzlas/ zlog pa dang bcas pa la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sngags brgya rtsa/ zlog pa tshar dgu/ de nas shes rab snying po'i sngags tshar bcu gcig zlog pa tshar gsum mgor skyabs 'gro dang bcas pa/ de nas 'jam dbyangs nag po'i sngags dang / tshe sgrub rdzas sngags tshar bcu gcig zlog pa tshar gsum mgor skyabs 'gro dang bcas pa/ de nas 'jam dbyangs nag po'i sngags dang / tshe sgrub rdzas sngags/ dug srung zab mo'i sngags brgya rtsa re re/ de nas gtor ma brgya rtsa la/ /skyabs 'gro nyer gcig ma ṇi brgya rtsa/ mgron tshan thams cad la saṃ bha ra bcu gcig re/ gong gi nyams len de rnams gang rigs kyi mtshams nam langs te lag ris mthong ba tsam gyi dus/ nam mkha' zas su bza' ba'i man ngag lan bdun re bsgom/ gtor ma brgya rtsa grub mtshams der dbang khrid lung man ngag sogs 'chad nyan stobs chen po yod pa'i skabs dang / sgrub mchod rgyud 'don gtor zlog bsgrub pa sogs kyi skabs 'di rnams yod skabs nyams len zab mo rnams kyi rlung sbyor dang bzlas pa'i grangs rnams nyung ngu re byed/ rnams ma gtogs dus thams cad du gzhi byes gang du yang pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig sogs la bsam/

gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams shog bu mda' tshad ma re blo 'dzin ma chag pa bgyid 'di 'grul sogs kyi stabs nas ma chag pa rang mi yongs 'dug dpe shog chung ba rnams nas shog grangs gnyis tsam re bzung te mda' tshad ma'i rtsis 'grig par byed/ de grub rjes lang te rten gyi drung du phyag dang bcas/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs tshar bcu gcig gam gsum re/ de nas bzang spyod nas yan lag bdun pa bla ma so so'i gsol 'debs brgyud 'debs mtshan brgya sogs ngag 'don 'di rnams phyogs 'grul gyi skabs rta khar byed/ 'byung ba'i ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs bcad so so lan gzhan ma bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len zab mo rnams kyang rta thog tu byas pas dpon slob kun gyi bar chad sel ba'i thabs mchog tu go /bcu gcig gam gsum re brjod cing / phyag dang bshags pa'i bar la brten la phyag bya zhing / gzhan rnams sa la 'dug la byed/ de nas nged rang gi bla ma rnams la gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus rnams dang / dpal mchog ma/ rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ gang drin ma/ dpal ldan brtan g.yo ma daṇ+ḍa ka sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma rnams 'don bar la bskor ba byed/ de nas zas kyi rnal 'byor grub rjes/ nyams len gyi gtso bo'i thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor yang yang gsal 'debs pa'i ngang nas/ bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs kyis dus 'da' bar byed cing / de nas snga dgong gi thun gnyis kyi mtshams 'dir skabs su gang babs la/ rnam rgyal dang rnam 'joms gyi gzungs ring tshar gsum re/ u tsa'i sngags ring nyer gcig gzhan ma u tsa'i sngags thung / sme brtsegs/ khyung nag rta mgrin lcags ral can rnams kyi sngags brgya rtsa re bzla/ phyi dro'i cha la babs te nyi ma mdung gang tsam gyi ma bzhud pa'i dus su sleb pa dang bstun/

rten gyi drung du phyag dang bcas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs tshar bcu gcig gam gsum re/ de nas bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa'i tshig bcad so so lan bcu gcig gam gsum re brjod cing / phyag dang bshags pa'i bar la rten la phyag bya zhing / gzhan rnams sa la 'dug la byed/ de nas lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig rje bla ma'i gsol 'debs brgya rtsa re/ de nas lam zab nang ma la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig de nas bir srung nang ma la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig rlung sbyor bdun nam gsum re/ de nas kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa lam dus kyi dbang 'bring du blangs ba dang / dbang bzhi'i mtshams su brda chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len dang bcas pa la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yig brgya nyer gcig rdzogs rim gyi skabs su/ rlung sbyor gyi rgyal po kha sbyor lan bdun re/ gtum mo 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa lan bdun/ aṣ+ṭa so gcig de nas 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yig brgya nyer gcig rdzogs rim zab mo dpyid thig gi man ngag lan nyer gcig gam bcu gcig gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags ring tshar gsum re dang / sngags thung rnams brgya rtsa re/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags lan bdun tsam re/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len rje bla ma'i gsung rgyun zab mo du mas brgyan pa la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yig brgya nyer gcig oṃ gsum ma brgya/ yid bzlas rlung sbyor bdun re/ chig brgyud kyi 'pho ba la nan tan dang bcas pa/ de nas phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi sgom bzlas la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sngags thung brgya/ sngags ring nyer gcig de nas bla ma yi dam lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig de wa pi tsu brgya/

yi ge bdun ma sum brgya/ e ka dza ti'i sngags nyer gcig lha mo'i ro ru brgya/ las mgon mo'i bod pa nyis brgya/ pho'i bod pa brgya/ pho mo'i rbad bsad sum cu re/ rlung sbyor bdun/ de nas bla ma rin 'byung la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig maṇ+ḍal bdun ma tshar drug dang so bdun ma gcig phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal tshig bcad ma tshar re/ de nas zhal bzhi pa'i tshe sgrub srung 'khor gur bdun ma la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yi dam kyi sngags dang gur mgon gyi yi ge bdun ma/ dpal mgon rang gi gzungs thung rnams brgya rtsa re re/ dpal mgon gyi gzungs ring po gcig oṃ a yur+dzñā na sogs nyer gcig srung ba dang bzlog pa'i sngags brgya rtsa re/ rlung sbyor bdun re/ de nas nged rang la blo gtad bcol ba'i gshin po rnams kyi don du dmigs pa'i smon lam gyi rim pa/ la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i tshad med bzhi bsgom rjes/ nged rang sku mched gsum gyi yum lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo zhing brjes dus nged rang gis brtsams pa'i smon lam rgyas pa tshar gcig dang / bsdus pa tshar bcu gcig ngan song sdug bsngal sogs dang / rgyal pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs lan nyer gcig re/ bkra shis kyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa/ de nas dbyug gu ma'i sngags brgya rtsa re/ de nas bka' shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i gcod kyi zab khrid gdan thog gcig tu nyams su blangs ba la/ skyabs 'gro rgyas bsdus tshar bdun/ sbyin gtong dkar 'gyed dmar 'gyed gsum skabs su gang babs lan bdun re'am gsum re byed cing / mjug tu smon lam gyi mtha' brgyan pa/ de nas skabs 'dir phur chung gtor bsngo skang gso rnams byed pa ni byes 'grul gyi skabs rnams su yin la/ dus rgyun gyis byed mtshams ni 'og na yig chung du bkod yod pas de bzhin byed tshe gcod kyi zab khrid kyi nyams len grub rjes rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi srung ba dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug go

/rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa las/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig ki+ā la ya brgya rtsa/ de nas yi dam kyai rdor/ bde mchog chos skyong gur lha brgyad/ dmag zor ma/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud phur srung bcu gnyis/ mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma phul rjes/ yi dam chos skyong so so'i bzlas pa cung zad re dang / bshags pa grub rjes/ bskang gso nag po mchod rten sogs gang 'os 'chag med du bgyid cing / tshes brgyad gnyis dang / bcu gnyis sogs dus gtor zab rgyas 'bul ba'i dus rnams su/ bskang ba bstod pa rgyas pa sogs yab mes gong ma'i phyag len gyi bsgrigs rim bzhin ma 'chug pa bgyid la/ dus rtag tu thun gtor phul rjes yig brgya sogs mjug chog rnams grub pa dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi srung ba thun mong ba la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig aṅgu li bco lnga re/ de nas nyams len gyi gtso bo'i nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug cing sang nyin tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis lang ba sogs gong bkod ltar las g.yo med du bgyis te mdor na phyi'i kun spyod 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i ngang nas/ nang gi nyams len theg chen sems bskyed dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas mchog tu zab pa bla med rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam la chig bsgril du bgyid pa'i lugs legs/ de lta bu'i sdom gsum so so'i snying po'am/ ngo bo 'di ltar yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas 'khor ba'i btson ra las/ gtan du thar pa'i rnam par grol ba dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu don gnyer ba'i blos/ gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa dug bzhin du spangs te 'dod chung chog shes bsten pa ni so thar sdom pa'i ngo bo yin la/ ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dngos rgyu sel ba'i slad du don gnyis mthar phyin kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod yid la byed pa'i blos/

rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i sems spangs te/ gzhan phan bsam sbyor bsten pa ni byang sems kyi sdom pa'i ngo bo yin la/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas rang sems 'khrul pas bslad pa la brten/ rtog pas btags pa'i snod bcud sogs tha mal pa'i snang ba 'di rnams snang stong rang bzhin lha sku bde stong chen po'i rol par gdod ma nas gnas pa la/ de ltar du ngo shes pa'i tshul gyis de'i rgyun la goms 'dris bsten pa ni sngags kyi sdom pa'i ngo bo yin no/ /mdor na srid pa'i yon tan gyi nyes pa rnams shes pa'i sgo nas/ de la chags pa spongs pa'i thabs nyams su len pa so thar dang / srid pa las rang gzhan gnyis ka grol 'dod kyi bsam pas de'i thabs nyams su len pa byang sems dang / srid zhis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad dag pa rab 'byams lha'i dkyil 'khor dang / de yang bde stong chen po'i rol par gdod ma nas gnas pa la de ltar du rang ngo shes pa'i tshul la goms 'dris bsten pa la sngags kyi sdom pa zhes 'jog pa legs par rang re rnams gzugs chos par 'dug kyang / grong ma'i skye bo ser chas gyon pa dang khyad med par/ kha nas chos byed zer yang / snying phur tshe 'di'i 'dun ma la btab nas/ /rnyed bkur dang zas nor la sems dung nge byed/ thos bsam sgom sgrub sogs gang byed kyang tshe 'di'i che thabs kyi bsgrub phyogs kho nar song ba zhig las mi 'ong ba gda' ba/ spyod tshul 'di ni rang gzhan kun gnyis phung gi las la sbyor ba 'dug pas re ma legs/ chos pa ming don dang ldan par 'dod na nyams len gyi chos dang sems dbyer med du 'dres pa zhig dgos pa gda' ste/ de spongs ba la nyams len gang byed kyi/ mgo skyabs 'gro nas mjug nam rdzogs kyi bar tha mal rnam rtog gi rgyun rbad kyis bcad nas yang tshig rjes su sems hri li li 'brangs ba zhig dgos par 'dug mod kyang de shin tu dka' bar gda'/

de ltar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / mi lus thang cig tsam thob pa'i skabs 'dir skye ba gtan legs kyi 'dun ma zin pa'i chos gsha' ma zhig bsgrub pa las gal che ba'i bsgrub rgyu gzhan med pa'i tshul bka' bstan bcos gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams las mgrin gcig tu gsungs shing / kho bo cag gi rje bla ma mus pa chen pos kyang de bzhin gyis rgyas bshad don bsdus yang yang bka' stsal te skal bzang dad ldan gyi snying la sim par mdzad la/ rje sems dpa' chen pos kyang bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang la gnang ba'i zhal gdams las/ rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob dus/ /bshes gnyen dam pa bsten nas/ /lam bzang nyams su len pa/ /bsod nams bsags pa yin no/ /nyams su len pa'i chos la/ /glo snying brang gsum gtad nas/ /gzhan gyi rnam rtog spongs la/ /sems dang chos su bsres shig /'di phyi bar do gsum du/ /de yi bslu ba med pas/ /zhes sogs dang / yang bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang la rje sems dpa' chen pos gnang ba'i thugs dam gsung shog 'ga' zhig las/ skabs don hril gyis dril na/ /khyed kyi bsam pa la sngon gyi las ngan pa'i dbang gis bsam pa bzhin thog tu song ba ma byung snyam nas sems las che bar 'dug na'ang / spyir 'o skol rnams kyi tshe 'di gcig blos ma thong na/ ji ltar byas kyang 'dod pa ma 'grub pa dang / mi 'dod pa 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal la sangs ba'i dus yong ba de ru mi gda'/ des na tshe 'dis bya byed gra zur ma nyams pa'i steng nas 'dod pa 'grub pa dang / mi 'dod pa bral ba'i bde skyid la re ma re mi gda'/ da tshe 'di gcig blos btang / mi zla nas bud/ nam med la rdog pa gtad nas blo phugs chos la gtad nas mi 'dod pa dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal yong don mi gda' ste/ da lta rang re rnams la mi 'dod pa thog tu byung ba'i sdug bsngal du snang ba 'di gtso cher tshe 'di'i 'dun ma ma grub pa'i sdug bsngal ka shas che ba gda' ba/

tshe 'di blos btang na tshe 'di'i don ma grub pa skyon du mi 'dug yon tan du 'dug pa/ khyad par du kha nang du bltas nas bsam mno zhib tu btang na/ 'dod pa ma 'grub pa'i sdug bsngal yong pa rang mi gda' ste/ rgyu mtshan 'di ltar/ rang re rnams kyi rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rkyen gang yang med pa thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par tshangs nges pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis dgyes bzhin du rjes su bzung / /de'i bka' drin las sangs rgyas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du yang dag pa'i bla ma brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las 'ongs ba'i gdams ngag tshig don la 'khrul pa'i dri mas ma gos pa/ rang gi skal ba dang 'bad rtsol gyis byung na gdams ngag gi ngos nas tshe 'di nyid la sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho drung nas 'byin zhing / sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa ji snyed cig thob nas gda' ba/ 'di la gzu bo'i blos dpyad na ngo mtshar ba'i bshes gnyen 'di lta bu'i rmad du byung ba'i gdams ngag bstan nas yang dag pa'i don phyin ci ma log par nyams su blangs bas chog pa'i dus byung ba 'di ni snyigs ma'i dus 'di 'grub la ma thang ba'i don chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di tsam grub nas gda' ba/ 'di bdag gi smra mkhas sam/ ngo bsrung ngam/ zhen pho rus la brten pa'i tshig tu 'dug mi 'dug khyed rang gis legs par dpyad pas shes pa yin no/ /'on kyang sngar don chen 'grub kyang da mjug 'di la gcig ma gzab na ni/ don chen 'grub pa yang ming tsam du song / tshe 'di'i gtam bzang ngan cung zad tsam dang / tshig mtho dman cung zad re dang skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma rjes sor shor/ mthar don cung zad ma 'grub kyang ma grub pa gcig dang khyad par gtan du sang shor shin tu che bas/

phyogs 'di la legs par gzob cig 'bad pa thon cig ces dang / yang spyir bde sdug gi snang ba 'di sems rang rang gi dge sdig gi las kyi 'bras bur gda'/ de'i stobs kyi dge sdig gi las kyi bag chags mang po rgyu ldan gyi 'gro ba du ma zhig phyogs gcig tu 'tshogs pa la bde sdug dang gtam bzang ngan sna tshogs yong ba 'di kun gyi spyi lugs su 'dug pas gang du bltas kyang de ka'i rang bzhin du gda'/ de la gtam bzang ba la dga' dang ngan pa la mi dga' ba bya rin chog par mi 'dug ste/ de gnyis ka yang tshe 'di'i snang ba dar tsam gcig tu 'dug pas zhes sogs gsungs shing / yang rje sems dpa' chen pos dge slong blo rin la gnang ba'i zhal gdams las/ 'di phyi bar do gsum gyi nyams len gyi gnad dril ba dgos zer ba la/ spyir chos gang nyams su len kyang nyams len gcig gi steng du 'di phyi bar gsum gyi nyams len tshangs ba'i gnad gcig shes dgos pa yin/ de'i gnad 'di las med/ rang gang la nyams len byed pa'i chos de la glo snying brang gsum gtad de/ shes pa 'jur mig nas drangs te dol chod du sbyangs pas/ rang gi shes rgyud kyi steng du chos de'i bag chags brtan po zhig bzhag thub na 'di phyi bar gsum gang du yang chos des phan pa yin/ de ma yin pa'i shes pa rgya yan la btang ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs mang po zhig bsags kyang dgos sa ru sleb pa dka'/ de lta bu'i gnad de ring sang gi nyams len la sbyar na rnam rtog mang po'i spun thag bcad nas/ rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob/ yi dam gyi lha khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgom bzlas tshul bzhin du byed rgyu yod pa bsod nams bsags pa yin/ da 'di phyi bar gsum thams cad du yi dam lha'i sgom bzlas dang mi 'bral ba zhig bya dgos snyam du blo thag gting nas bcad nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i sgom bzlas la dol chod du sbyongs ba las zab pa'i man ngag med de/

de ltar ma shes par rang nyams su len pa'i chos de logs su bzhag nas/ 'di phyi bar do gsum du mkho ba'i chos shig zur du 'tshol du phyin yang ngal ba don med cig las mi yong ba yin/ gnad 'di shes na chos gang nyams su len kyang / 'di phyi bar gsum gyi nyams len du 'gro ba yin no/ /'pho ba dang bar do la sogs pa rnams kyang / /gnad 'di bzhin byung na kun yod/ 'di bzhin ma byung na gang gis kyang phan par dka' ba yin/ /gang ltar kyang tshe 'di'i rgyal kha ma nyams pa'i steng nas chol tshul bzhin du byung ba'i lo rgyus thos ma myong / rang gzhan pas 'bur dod cig 'dod na/ chos nyams len gzhan pas 'bur dod cig byed pa de ka yin mod/ zhes pa'i rdo rje'i tshig 'di rnams rang gi sems la phan zhing dge sbyor la bogs 'don khyad par can re yongs kyin 'dug pa nas 'dir bris pa yin pas/ gzhan chos tshul bzhin du dpyad pa'i gang zag rnams kyis kyang tshigs don 'di rnams yid la 'jags par mdzod/ de ltar yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du sgo gsum chos kyi bya ba la bskul ba'i dran gso gsal 'debs kyi yi ge 'di bri ba'i rkyen ni sngar sor rang lo bco brgyad lon pa'i kun dga'i lo/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' las khyod kyi rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs bor te gdung spel sogs gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi khur len byed dgos pa'i phebs sgo nan chen du stsal skabs/ chos phyir du thabs sna thogs kyi sgo nas grol cha nan tan bskyed nas zhus pas mthar dgongs pas bde grol byung rung / zhu shin tu dka' bar byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams dran pa dang / rje rgyal ba mus pa chen pos 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya yang yang stsal ba'i snying por tshe 'di glog dang 'dra bas khyem tsam cig ka yin la/ yun thung 'di la dal 'byor don yod par bya ba'i phyir gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas par byas nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyis dus 'da' ba zhig cis kyang bya dgos shing /

rgyun pa'i dge sbyor nyams len gyi thun la 'jug pa sogs la yang nyi tshad grib tshad sogs kyi sgo nas bsgrigs la 'khyon pa zhig dang / de las dus nam yang mi 'da' ba zhig ci nas kyang gal che zhes gsungs pa rnams dran pa'i mod la dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang gi yang rtse e waṃ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas su yi ger bkod pa 'di'i rang gzhan thams cad 'phral dang yun du bde legs su gyur cig smras pa/ da dung chos bzhin spyod pa yi/ /bshes gnyen du mas rjes bzung ste/ /zab dang rgya che'i dam pa'i chos/ /rgya mtsho lta bu 'thung ba dang / /rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin shog /gong du bkod pa'i phur chung gtor bsngo bskang gso'i rim pa rnams/ skabs 'gar snga thun dgong thun gyi mtshams su byed cing / dus skabs phal cher du dgong thun gyi bla ma yi dam lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub dang / bla ma rin 'byung gi mtshams su byed la/ gong du bkod pa'i bzlas pa sogs kyi grangs nges gsal rnams mtshams bcad rgya ma yod tshe/ gong bkod ltar las cung nyung bar byas te mtshams kyi sngags thun sogs la ma gnod par byed/ sarba maṅgalaṃ/ kal+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //dgos ched khyad par can gyi tshe/ /med thabs med pa'i yi ge bzhugs/167 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dgos byed khyad par can gyi dbang gis bslab pa 'bul ba'i cho ga nyams su len pa la/ sbyor ba ston pa'i sku'i drung du mchod pa bshams te/ dngos gzhi rten gyi drung du rang nyid yan lag bdun pa 'don bzhin pas phyag mang du byas la/ de nas thal mo sbyar 'dug la/ bslab pa 'bul ba'i bsngags tshig ni/ ngag tu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub dpa' dang / don gyi slad du/ mtshan nas smos te/ dpal brtse ba chen po'i zhal snga nas/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i ngo bo ston pa thub pa'i dbang po bdag la dgongs su gsol/

bdag shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bgyi ba/ gang gi tshe gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa las/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / khyad par dpal sa skya pa'i bstan pa sde dang bcas pa 'dzin byed dam pa 'od gsal lha las babs pa'i dri med 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rin po che spel ba'i dgos byed khyad par can gyi rkyen gyis bdag gsol bzhi'i cho ga las thob cing khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi bdag nyid can dge slong gi sdom pa 'bul lo/ /rags sdom bcu phyogs mthun dang bcas pa'i dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bul lo/ skabs 'dir chos gos lhung bzed sogs rten gyi drung du phul na legs par sems so/ /mi tshangs spyod spongs ba'i bshes bsnyen gyi bslab pa 'bul lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bdag rtsa ba bzhi chang dang bcas pa spongs pa'i yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin par gzung du gsol/ ces brjod/ rjes theg chen sems bskyed kyi zin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po de nyid bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs zhes pa 'di ni 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba dang / 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud mchan shin tu zhib pa dang bcas pa dang / bu ston rin po che'i 'dul ṭīka chen mo/ 'phags pa rin po che'i dngos slob rgya byang seng gi 'dul ṭīka shin tu gsal ba dang / sgra pa shes rab rin chen gyi 'dul ṭīka ngo mtshar can sgra ṭīka tu grags pa rnams zhib tu dpyad cing / gzhan yang 'dul ba'i spyi ṭīka tshad thub du ma nas legs bshad kyi cha blangs te bris pa yin pas lugs 'di'i cho ga 'di bas don tshangs ba zhig dgos pa med pas dregs ldan cher rloms rnams kyis ma go ba'i gtam ma smra zhig /kal+ya na war+dhan+tu/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ//

༈ //dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyi rang lo nyer lnga lon skabs nyin zhag phrug re'i dge sbyor nyams len gyi rim pa rnams dang 'phral gyi kun spyod rnams chos dang mthun par spyod pa'i tshul dran gso gsal 'debs kyi yi ge bzhugs/168 badz+ra dha ra bud+dha dha dza ye /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag dpal ldan he ru ka dpal nyid/ /zhing 'dir la la ngur smrig gos 'chang 'ga' zhig gos dkar lcang lo'i mdzes/ ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol rtsed du mas gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba skyong / /de lta'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog dam pa kho bo'i 'dren pa yab sras rgyal/ /de ltar mchod par brjod nas rang nyid kyi/ /dge sbyor nyams len dran gso'i yi ge bri/ /'di bzhin nyams su long la 'di phyi'i don/ /'bad med yid bzhin 'grub par yongs 'dzin rje/ /gcig chog rgyal po gang des byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ de la nged rang chung ngu nas chos kyi bag chags ches che ba'i stobs kyis gzhon nu rab byung bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas mi tshe bshad sgrub kyis 'da' ba zhig 'dod kyang / dus kyi dbang gis bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa zhig rang ngos nas ngal ba lhur len ma bgyis na/ spyir bod khams kyi bde skyid dang / bstan pa yongs/ lhag par sa skya'i rtsa ba stong pa la thug pa nas mi theg bzhin du gdan sa'i lugs gnyis kyi khur 'di bzhin khyer dgos byung pa/ 'di bzhin dgos pa'i lung bstan bka' chems kyi tshul du bdag gi bla ma rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyis yang yang du bka' stsal ba bzhin thog tu babs pa yin te/ de yang rang lo brgyad gnyis lhag tsam lon pa'i skabs su/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung las/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa la gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong 'di las gal che ba mi 'dug cing /

'di'i 'dzin skyong yang zhal ngo na rim bzhin gyi gzhol pa la bka' babs pa zhig yod pa dang / lhag par bsam yas chos skyong chen pos kyang / rdo rje gdan gyi 'dzin skyong rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul gyi gzhon pa de la bka' babs yod do zer ba theng gnyis rang nged rang la yi ge byung ba sogs gang nas bsam kyang khyod kyi gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pa'i rab byung gi brtul zhugs 'di dor nas nged rang bzhin bgyis na/ nga yang bsam pa de kas rdzogs shing / nged rang gi gzugs po'i nam lcogs bar khur yang len pa dang / de ltar byas na rang re la dgra gnyen grogs gsum sus kyang bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis mi tshugs pa sogs thugs kyi dkyil nas bzhar ba'i lung bstan bslab ston gyi tshogs dran pa tsam gyis mig chu rang dbang med pa 'chor ba du ma lhug stsol du gnang ba dang / yang dus de'i skabs shig nged rang ngam ring na yod skabs thugs dam phyag ris ma zhig gnang byung ba'i nang na/ ngos ni nyer dgu'i zla bar 'dug bstan pa la gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong las khag che ba mi 'dug pa sogs zhib cha mtha' dag ngos kyi gleng ba ltar yin pas sa skya zer ba'i ming yongs mong la rgyas byung ba/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum la blo khur bskyed pa rang gal che che gsungs ba 'dug pa de dus ni rang blun pas ma go yang / phyis bsam pas sngags 'chang nyid rang dag pa'i zhing du myur du phebs pa'i dgongs pa de dus nas gtad pa'i gsung du 'dug cing / yang de'i dus zhig gi tshe nged rang gi rdo rje phur pa'i dbang bskur bgyid skabs/ dbang yon du rgyal ba byams pa'i sku li ma dngos gtsang zhig byung ba/ sngags 'chang nyid la spyan lam phabs pas/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung las/ 'di rten 'brel bzang / byams pa'i bstan pa ma shar bar gdung spel byas nas sdod zer ba'i rten 'brel yin gsungs byung ba dang / yang de'i dus skabs shig gsung las/

nged kyi 'ang sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' chems snying la bcangs nas gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong gi ched du phyi nang gsang gsum nas yid chad gtong ba mang du byung yang bzod rang bsam pa byas bsran bskyed pas sa skya ming ma stong tsam byung ba yin/ da cha khyod kyi nged la mi nyan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum mi byed na/ nga yang su la bsam nas sdod du 'dug gang na'ang nged kyi sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' chems blos ma thong ba bzhin/ nged kyi ngag kyang khyod kyi mi gcog pa byed dgos/ de bzhin ma byas na gong la ye shes spyan ldan rnams thugs khrel 'gro zhes gsungs shing / yang dus phyis rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i rten bzhengs gnang skabs nged kyi rten gsar bzhengs blo la yod pa ltar 'di rnams kyi mjug khyed la bsgril dgos pa yong / zhes yang yang du gsungs ba sogs bka' stsal ba thams cad thog tu khel byung bas/ rang ngos nas gdan sa'i khur 'di tsam mi lcogs pa la thug 'dug kyang 'di bzhin gyis khur byas pas/ rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor de nyid kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs rgyur 'dug pas gtso bor 'di kho na bsam pa dang / yang 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos kyang dus phyis gsung las da ni gdan sa'i khur 'di khyed rang gi byas na ma byas na rang 'di ka yin tshul sku dngos su yang bka' nan stsal zhing / lhag par zhing mi brje tsam gyi sku snyel ba'i skabs shig thugs dam phyag bris ma zhig phebs byung ba'i nang na/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'di rtsa brlag la mi 'gro tsam zhig byed na/ sgar pa'i khams su bsdad gdung spel byas/ khyed rang gi sa skyar gdung spel byas nas ma 'chags pa zhig byas na ma byas na rang du 'dug pa dgongs 'tshal/ nged 'chi kha ma tsho la de'i byus dgos rgyu mi 'dug gsungs 'dug pa nas/ rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang rdo rje 'chang ngur smrig bla gos 'chang ba dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i gsung las kyang /

khyed rang ring por mi thogs pa log bsgrub thams cad nam mkha' la deng nas kun kyang dbang du 'dus pa'i chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor 'bad med lhun grub kyi sgo nas zang zing gi longs spyod sogs blos mi 'khyud pa tsam yong zhes gsungs ba sogs dang yang gling dga' chos grwa zur du bde mchog rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams gnang skabs rgyud zab mo 'di rnams phugs yul sa skya'i sngags dgon bde chen gling du rgyud 'don thabs rgyas pa re khyed rang gi rtsoms la tshugs shig gsungs ba dang / yang sa skya pa drag zhan med khyed rang la mgo 'bul lus 'bul byed pa zhig yong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa sogs dus phyis 'di bzhin gyi gdan sa'i khur dgos pa'i lung bstan nges shes can mang du yod kyang 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris la rgyu mtshan des na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ sems can gyi bde skyid/ lhag par dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa sde gdung brgyud dang bcas pa snying khong bcangs pa'i rang nyid gcig po zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo rgyang ring du spangs/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi go cha bzang po gyon te/ lhag bsam bzang pos kun nas blangs pa'i nyan thos 'dul ba nas bshad pa'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / dge tshul dang tshangs spyod kyi bslab pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srung bar khas blangs pa de nyid de las nyams pa dang / phyis blangs du med pa sogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir dam chos 'dul ba rang nas gsungs pa ltar gyi bslab pa 'bul chog tshul bzhin du bgyis pa'i yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas par bgyis te/ dpal ldan sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi 'khur 'di bzhin 'khur ba la brten pa'i rnam g.yengs ches pa nas/

rgyun gyi dge sbyor ngag 'don spros med sogs gang yang mthil phyin rang zhig mi yong 'dug kyang / phran bu yong ba la'ang le lo dang bsgyid lhug gi sreb 'gyangs su 'gro ba rang zhig yong gis 'dug pas de bzhin mi 'byung ba'i dran gsos gsal 'debs kyi yi ge 'di bri bar bya'o/ /de yang tho rangs nyams len gyi gtso bo ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs te/ thog mar tshe sgrub zab mo chig brgyud ma/ de nas bir srung thun mong ba/ de nas lam zab thun mong ba/ de nas dkar cha bzhi dang nor lha dbyug gu ma'i chang bu 'bul ba/ de nas lam dus rgyas pa brda chig brgyud kyi man ngag dang bcas pa/ de nas bde mchog dril bu pa'i mngon rtogs/ de nas nā ro mkha' spyod/ 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa/ de nas 'byung 'dul gyi sgom bzlas/ de nas srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma/ de nas bla ma rin 'byung gi nyams len/ de nas zhal bzhi pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo gur bdun ma/ de nas nged rang du blo gtad bcol ba'i gshin po rnams la dmigs pa'i smon lam/ de nas seng gdong ma'i bzlog pa/ de nas gtor ma brgya rtsa/ de nas rnam rgyal 'joms/ 'jam nag u tsa'i sngags ring thung / sme brtsegs/ dbang bsdud/ dug sngags zab mo rnams so/ /de rnams 'gro rlung sbyor/ gsol 'debs/ maṇ+ḍal/ sngags ring thung rnams ci nus re bya'o/ /de rnams grub rjes sgrub mchod rgyun 'don gtor zlog gtor sgrub sogs kyi brel ba med skabs gsung rab zab mo rnams nas dpe 'dzin shog ldeb re tsam ma chag pa byed cing / de nas nyin bar gyi cha sogs 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug bza' btung / thos bsam 'chad nyan sogs gang byed kyang spros bral gyi lta bas gnad zab mo gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi rang babs la mnyam par 'jog ci thub dang / nyams len gyi gtso bo'i rnal 'byor dang mi 'bral ba'i dran 'dun drag pos yang yang bskyed cing /

de nas sgrub mchod sogs gong bkod ltar gyi brel ba med skabs phyi dro'i cha la bab pa na rang gi bsam gtan khang bur 'dug ste/ thog mar lam zab thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ de nas bir srung thun mong ma yin pa/ de nas lam dus 'bring po brda chig brgyud kyi nyams len dang bcas pa/ de nas nā ro mkha' spyod 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa/ de nas gur mgon lha brgyad sbags sgrub/ de nas bla ma rin 'byung / de nas zhal bzhi pa'i tshe bsgrub zab mo/ de nas snga dro bzhin gyi smon lam/ de nas nor lha dbyug gu ma'i bzlas pa/ de nas phur chung gtor bsngo/ bskang gso/ de nas gcod gdan thog gcig tu nyams su blangs ba/ de nas bir srung thun mong ba/ de nas nyams len gyi gtso bo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug cing / ngag 'don spros bcas kyi dge sbyor/ de rnams kyi skyabs 'gro/ gsol 'debs/ rlung sbyor/ maṇ+ḍal/ sngags ring thung sogs kyi grangs de rnams ci nus su bya'o/ /yang sang nang par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi lang ba la sogs mdor na lo zla khor yug tu dge sbyor gyi gnad zab mo'i rtsis zin pa'i spyod lam zab mos dus 'da' bar byed do/ /zhes pa 'di yang sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i thugs rje'i byin brlabs kyi 'di phyi'i don bde blag tu 'grub par re ba'i yid gnyis med pa'i blo lhing khel ba'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngar lo nyer gsum lon pa'i dge slong gi rten gyi skabs dge sbyor nyams len gyi dran gso'i yi ge zhig byas mod kyang / de nyid ha cang mang ches pa nas da cha gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong gi rnam g.yengs dang bstun pa'i nyams len cung ma bde ba la mos pa'i blos yi ge 'di bzhin bris pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du bde legs su gyur cig

'di sbyar dge bas bdag dang gdul bya rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma thog med bde ba can skyes nas/ /sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i 'dren par shog /yang smras pa/ rang sems gdod nas rnam par dag pa 'di/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med par/ /shes nas rtag tu mnyam par 'jog pa 'di/ /zab mo'i yang rtse sgom pa'i rim par gsungs/ /dus rnams kun du rje btsun bla ma dang / /'bral med bsgom pa lam gyi snying por bshad/ /des na nyams len zab mo'i rim pa 'di/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi dus kun 'da' ba gces/ /man ngag dran shes rtag tu bsten pa dang / /bla ma lhar bsgom rang lus lha sku mchod/ /'khrul rjes mi gcod snyug ma'i rang zhal lta/ /mnyam rjes kun du dgos pa'i gnad 'di'o/ /zhes shugs 'byung du smras so/ /ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu/ sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rje mus chen gyi dngul sku khyad par can gyi gzungs bzhugs kyi tho bzhugs/169 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dus gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams ma lus pa/ /kun gyi spro dang bsdud pa'i byed po gang / /yab gcig he ru ka dpal mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la snying nas 'dud/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ /bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba de nyid kyi sku 'dra dngul gar bu lugs la grub pa bzo khyad ngo mtshar can/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi bzhengs pa 'di nyid la gzungs bzhugs khyad par can rnams bzhugs pa'i tho la/ dbu gzungs la bde kye gtso bor gyur pa'i bla gzungs cha tshang sku gzungs dang bar gzungs la bde kye gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi gsang sngags zab mo rnams dang / gzungs chen lnga sogs zab la mang ba/ pad gzungs la chos skyong nor lha dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis gnod sbyin pho mo sogs kyi gzungs sngags rnams dang /

lhag par nged rang gi tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i bshad tshod dang mthun pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo rnams bzhugs shing / gzhan yang byin rlabs rten bzhugs pa la/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung dga' ldan nas byon pa/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku tshab gter lnga'i nang tshan bye ma a krong las grub pa'i sku las byon pa'i ring bsrel/ rje btsun chen po'i dbu thod las 'jam dbyangs kyi sku rang byon du 'khrungs pa'i dum bu/ rje btsun gyi tshem gyi dum bu/ gnam kha'u pa'i dbu thod la phyag rdor dang a yig rang byon 'khrungs pa'i dum bu/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi ring bsrel/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i ring bsrel/ bka' drin mnyam med sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi ring bsrel/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa de nyid rang gi dbu thod kyi dum bu sogs sku gdung stobs che ba dang / rje de nyid zhal bzhugs dus nged rang la gnang ba'i dbu lo bub/ yang bde mchog bsnyen chen mdzad dus sogs kyi dbu lo stobs che ba/ rje de nyid kyi rgyun pa'i bsgom zhwa phyi gos chen gyi byas pa sku drag shin tu che ba nged rang la byin rlabs rten du gnang ba de nyid bub ma nyams pa/ yang 'phel gdung gi phye ma dang / sa lo chen po/ theg chen rin po che/ bdag chen grags blo ba/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab bzang po/ bdag chen blo gros pa rnams kyi gdung rus btul ma sbyar ba'i ril bu/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal cher gyi gdung dang dbu lo sbyar ba'i ril bu/ sems dpa' chen po'i gdung / rgyal tshab dam pa'i gdung / bdag chen grags blo ba'i gdung / 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho'i gdung / bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gdung / dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa'i gdung / bram ze mched bdun gyi gdung dang ring bsrel gyi dum bu/ bse mkhar chung pa'i gdung / nyan chen pa'i gdung /

chos rje sa paṇa gyi gdung / bla ma dpal ldan seng ge'i gdung / rje mus chen gyi sku gzan dang sku rags kyi dum bu/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku bsgom dang sku'i aṃ rag gi dum bu/ sngags 'chang chen po dang / sngags 'chang grags pa blos gros rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gdung stobs che ba/ rje sa paṇa gyi gdung thal ring bsrel ma/ rje btsun grags pa'i phyag phreng khug gi dum bu/ rje kun dga' grol mchog gi dbu zhwa dum bu/ rje dkon mchog rgyal mtsho'i gdung / rje sangs rgyas rin chen kyi shangs mtshal dang chab ser ril bu/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge'i gdung / rje rin chen chos 'phel gdung / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi gdung / rje rdo rje 'chang gi 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyi gdung / rje yongs 'dzin gyi tshem gyi dum bu/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho'i dbu thod dum bu/ 'dren mchog dam pa'i phyag sen/ bram ze dri med snying po'i phyag mdzub kyi rkang 'om bu glang mkhar na gter du bzhugs pa/ gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyi gter nas spyan drangs pa'i dum bu/ theg chen pa'i gdung thal/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pa'i gdung / theg chen chos rje'i sku sha stobs che ba/ ma cig sangs rgyas re ma'i sku sha chos rje g.yag pa'i gdung / slob dpon pad+ma'i tshe ril/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ rje lha mchog seng ge sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sngags 'chang chen po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan rnams kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/ dbon ston skyer khang pa'i gdung / zha lu mkhyen rab chos rje'i gdung / bla ma mnyam med chen po'i gdung / paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rje'i gdung / paṇa chen shākya shrīs dbu lo/ sa lo'i dbu lo/ sngags 'chang chen po'i bde kye gnyis pa'i gsung bsnyen gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ yang sngags 'chang chen po'i sgo rum bse 'bag gi drung du shā sa na'i gsung bzlas gnang dus kyi dbu lo/

yang sngags 'chang chen po'i byas 'gyur du lo gsum gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ lam zab dang lam kyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi len pa gtsor bor mdzad de aṣ+ṭa 'bum phrag so gnyis gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ sngags 'chang de nyid kyi sku gdung ril bu las zhus pa'i dbu lo/ rje btsun grags pa'i dbu lo/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbu lo/ lo nas spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos grags kyi dbu lo/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi dbu lo/ sems dpa' chen po'i dbu lo/ grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis kyi dbu lo/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge'i dbu lo/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i dbu lo/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ glo bo mkhan chen gyi dbu lo/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i dbu lo/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge'i dbu lo/ gzhan yang dus phyis sngags 'chang chen po'i rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi dbu lo rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdu bar mdzad pa'i dbu skra kun 'dus stobs che ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang sa chen thun mong ba'i sku bem dum bu/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i na bza' dum bu/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku chas tshangs ma mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis 'phan yul lhun po rtser gser sku sku tshad kyi gzungs bzhugs la gnang ba dga' ldan pa'i dmag gis bshig nas bton pa chos rje kun dga' legs grub pa'i phyag tu byung ba/ sngags 'chang chen por phul ba'i sku chas kyi dum bu/ yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku rags kyi dum bu/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi sku chas kyi dum bu/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi spur ras/ kun mkhyen chen po'i sku gzan gyi dum bu/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'ching gi dum bu/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug gi gdung ras/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i sku chos kyi dum bu/ rgyal sras thogs med pa dang / kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/

rje sangs rgyas rin chen rnams kyi na bza'i dum bu/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbu zhwa'i dum bu/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi sku bem/ sku gzan/ sku sham gyi dum bu/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i shangs mtshal/ shangs snab/ dbu zhwa'i nang dar/ shangs phyis/ spur ras/ sku thabs/ sku rags kha tshar/ phur pa'i srung 'khor dbu thog tu phub pa dbu'i sku drag yod pa rnams kyi dum bu rnams bzhugs so/ /'dir smras pa/ 'brel tshad don ldan mus pa chen po yis/ /sku brnyan dngos dang 'dra ba'i ngo mtshar can/ /grangs med byin rlabs rin chen gter gyur 'di/ /ngag dbang kun dgas dad pa'i mthu las bskrun/ /skyon med bla ma dam pas rjes bzung ste/ /zab rgyas gdams pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod bzung nas/ /dngos grub thams cad bla ma kho na las/ /gzhan la mi re dam pa'i rnam thar yin/ /tshul 'di sngon tshe dpyod ldan yongs la grags/ /deng dus kho bo'i spyod yul las gzhan gang / /de phyir dam pa'i mgon gyis nyer bzung nas/ /shes nas dad pa thob 'di skal ba bzang / /zhes pa 'di ni sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po de nyid zab mo chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul bstan nas lo lnga lon pa chu khyi zla ba lnga pa'i rje bla ma de nyid kyi dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba la khad nye ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po de nyid kyis dngul sku gsar bzhengs la gzungs bzhugs rab gnas bgyis pa'i nyin yi ge 'di yang bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba'o/ /yi ge pa ni gdong dga' ba gso ba rig pa dang yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa bsam don 'grub kyis bgyis so/ /legs par byas pa'i bsod nams 'di yi mthus/

bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas pa dang / phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //shab sgo lnga'i yul ljongs khyad par can dge sdings srin po chos rdzong khams gsum zil gnon gyi mgon khang srid gsum rnam rgyal bzhengs dus bka' bsgo 'phrin bcol mdzad pa'i yi ge bzhugs/170 na mo gu ru puṇ+ya in+d+ra kirti ma ti bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ mahā ka li de wi ye/ tsa turmu kha/ badz+ra ka la yak+ṣa/ badz+ra ki la yak+ṣi ṇi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa pu tra/ badz+ra ru tra bha ṭa/ badz+ra ru lu rak+ṣa si sa pa ri wā ra/ sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo dpal ldan nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza ṭi/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma zhing skyong dbang phyug zhal bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi las kyi gshan pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo/ bka' nyan gnod sbyin yab yum/ khams gsum srog dbugs kyi bdag po las mkhan mon bu pu tra/ bha ṭa gser gyi spu gri ma/ 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ zhing skyong dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum/ dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis sogs sa skya pa'i bstan srung dbang po khyed rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dang / de'i thugs kyi sras mchog bdag gi bla ma 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul bsod nams dbang po/ byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam par 'phrul pa rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros ste sngags 'chang bla ma yab sras mtshungs med de gsum gyi thugs kyi dgongs pa bskangs ba'i phyir/
