skyes chen dam pa de dag gi rjes su zhugs pa'i slob bu'i tha chung du gyur pa dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bdag gi legs par bzhengs pa'i/ shab sgo lnga'i yul ljongs khyad par can dge sdings srin po chos rdzong khams gsum zil gnon gyi mgon khang ngo mtshar can srid gsum rnam rgyal du mtshan gsol ba rten dang brten par bcas pa 'di rnams la/ dpal sa skya'i bka' srung khyad par can mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyi mnga' bdag khyed rnams brtan par bzhugs la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srung / bstan pa skyong / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyong / khyad par lha 'di chos skyong 'di nyid kyi srung ma mdzad nas dge sdings bkra shis bsam 'grub/ bsam 'grub bde chen/ dge sdings sogs kyi thog drangs/ rang zhabs su gtogs pa'i chos gzhis skya ser skye 'gro kun gyi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad nas bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du dpal sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud 'di mched pa'i bka' 'bangs las dus nam du yang gzhan du skad cig tsam 'gyur ba med pa'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod cig gzhan yang shab sgo lnga'i yul ljongs na gnas pa kun kyang phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing / nga rgyal/ 'gran sems/ phrag dog dben skyo ma dkrug bcol sogs mi dge ba'i phyogs kun zhi nas sngags 'chang bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod cig bye brag tu rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsam don thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub cing / sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'byung ba dang / de dag gis kyang sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'dres med pa'i gsung rab la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang /

thos bsam sgom gsum gyis sgo nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa rnal ma lhad med 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / dpal sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i rgyun 'di nyid mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i thabs kho na byed cing nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig spyir yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du lo legs shing skya rgyal ba mi nad phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad cing mi 'byung ba dang / /dus kyi 'khrug pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba/ khyad par du dpal ldan sa skya dang / shab sgo lnga'i yul ljongs 'di nyid du mi la na tsha/ phyugs la god kha/ zhing la sad ser ba/ 'bu than pa/ kha ba la sogs pa'i lo dgra thams cad de/ mdor na 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las srung ba dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor ba/ snyan grags thams cad dang / chos dang mthun pa'i bsam pa chen po la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan gyi phyogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod cig spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrug pa/ skye 'gro yongs kyi bde skyid 'joms shing sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya dang / 'dra 'dri chos rdzong khams gsum zil gnon gyi yab 'bangs su gyur pa'i sde dang bstan par gtogs pa rnams la bsam pa ngan pa/ sbyor ba rtsub par byed pa'i sgo nas do bdo ba/ phod btsugs pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla gang na gnas pa thams cad myur du tshar bcad nas rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bskyal nas 'jig rten gyi khams su gnas pa thams cad rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig

mkhyen brtse nus ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dbyer med bstan srung dpa' bo khyed rnams kyis/ /sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /kye ma deng dus chos par rlom pa rnams/ /phal cher 'dir snang kho nas a 'thas kyis/ /phyi ma brjed nas byol song bzhin du 'chi/ /de phyir bdag gi yid smon 'di ltar gyur/ /g.yengs med chos mthun mthun rkyen la spyod cing / /mi tshe 'chad nyan sgrub la dril snyam kyang / /bstan pa'i rtsa ba dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /khur 'dis g.yengs bar gyur mod de lta na'ang / /phyi ltar 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bstan pa spel/ /nang du zab mo'i lam la rtse gcig dril/ /dus rnams kun du bla ma dkon mchog la/ /gsol ba 'debs 'di kho bo'i rnam thar legs/ /bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi bsam pa bzhin/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing re smon kun 'grub ste/ /bstan pa rgyas shing de rgyun bskal pa'i bar/ /gdung brgyud rgyun mi chad pas skyong gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma thugs rje'i gter mnga' zhing / /bka' srung rnams kyang mthu rtsal bsam las 'das/ /bdag cag lhag bsam dag pa'i nus mthu yis/ /bsam don ma lus 'bad med lhun grub shog /rje btsun bla ma skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum/ /yi dam chos skyong nor lha bcas rnams kyis/ /thugs rjes bdag dang bdag gi rigs brgyud kyis/ /khams gsum dbang du 'du ba'i bkra shis spyon/ /maṅgalaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ //legs bshad snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs bzhugs/171 tri ka la dzñāḥbud+dha dh+wa dza ye na maḥ 'dir smras pa/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla mas rje bzung zhing / /rim gnyis zab mo'i don la rab brtson pas/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob gcig tu 'dres pa yis/ /mtshan don ldan pa sngags 'chang rgyal mtsho'i tshogs/ /'dus pa'i dbus su rang lo nyer gcig la/ /lam mchog gsung ngag rin chen dga' ston spel/

/sngon chad tshe 'dir yun du ma sbyangs mod/ /'on kyang yongs 'dzin mchog gi bka' drin las/ /rgyas bshad don bsdus mtshams sbyar la sogs pa/ /gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i blo rgyas pas/ /thos pas rnar snyan bsam pas don bzang dang / /ldan phyir 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams mgrin gcig pas/ /khyod kyi gzhon nu'i lang tsho 'di 'dra la/ /legs par bshad pa'i ngo mtshar 'di lta bu/ /nges par 'jam dbyangs mi'i gzugs can zhes/ /bsngags pa brjod pa'i snyan tshig du ma yis/ /nyin mtshan 'da' ba'i dus 'di e ma mtshar/ /'on kyang kho bo byang gi mthar sleb pas/ /dad ldan slob ma'i tshogs dang sa yul gyi/ /skal bas da res kun don ma 'grub mod/ /de lta mod kyi da ni mi ring bar/ /snod ldan mtha' dag smin grol 'god par smon/ /de bzhin dad ldan rnams kyi yid la zung / /zhes pa 'di ni gnas lnga rig pa'i chos kyi rje/ /sa skya paṇa chen gang gi rnam thar bzang po la/ /smon pa'i sems ldan ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /shākya'i dge tshul sa skya pa des smras pa'o/ /dge'o// ༈ //sbyor drug bsgom dus kyi nyams dbyangs rang sems bde stong gi myu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/172 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde kye'i lam bzang sogs bsgom pas/ /sbyor drug nyams rtags kun shar ba'i/ /rje btsun mus pa las chen po/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang ltos bcas kyi bu slob/ /'di kun thugs rje yis zung la/ /dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ldan du drongs shig /deng dus sprul pa yi skyes chen/ /spyan snga chos rje yi drung du/ /dus 'khor smin grol rnams nos tshe/ /nyams shar glu dbyangs 'di 'then no/ mig gnyis/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba yi lta stangs/ /nyi zla sgra gcan gsum bcings thabs/ rkang pa gnyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis gnad kyis/

/bshang gci khu ba yi rtsa bsdams/ /khu tshur brla steng du bsrangs 'di/ /ro rkyang dbu ma ru 'jug thabs/ /pho ba g.yo med kyi bar rlung / /rgyun 'dzin ting 'dzin gyi gzhi ma/ /steng skyon 'og sgo yi gnad dang / /'og gegs steng rlung gi sel byed/ /skyil krung rnam gsum gyi gnad 'di/ /dus 'khor rgyud rgyal gyi snying po/ rang sems/ /ma bcos yid byed dang bral bar/ /yengs med mnyam gzhag tu bskyangs pas/ /las rlung dbu ma ru thim nas/ /gzung 'dzin rnam rtog kun yal te/ /'gag med stong gzugs kyi rang bzhin/ /'khor 'das sna tshogs kyi ltad mo/ /myong yang myong stong gi blo 'das/ /gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi ngo bo/ /lta rgyu med pa la bltas pas/ /mthong rgyu med pa ru mthong nas/ /sgom du med pa'i tshul bsgom pas/ /grol rgyu med pa'i sems grol ba'i/ /'char sgor ngo mtshar can 'di dang / /rgyun du 'bral med du 'grogs te/ /tshe rabs gtan legs kyi 'dun ma/ /dus 'dir 'bad med du zin par/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yis byin rlob/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro yis grogs mdzod/ /chos skyong srung ma yis las sgrub/ /e ma rnal 'byor de blo bde/ /zhes pa'i nyams dbyangs rang sems bde stong gi myu gu zhes bya ba 'di yang / /sa skya pa gdod nas rang grol sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ sngon gyi skyes chen rje btsun tshul khrims 'bar gyi sku'i rnam par thar par sprul pa/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub kyi drung du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid zhus dus/ bzhi thog bla brang gi rab gsal sbug gi mun khang du lus gnad dam po dang bcas khrid dmigs kyi dge sbyor la chig bsgril bgyis skabs/ /nyams la gang shar 'byung rung gi yon tan la smon pa'i tshul du glur blangs ba 'dis/ rang gzhan gyis rgyud la bde chen gyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig

/ces pa'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis don 'grub bo/ /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //sbyor drug bsgom dus kyi nyams dbyangs rang sems bde stong gi rang gzugs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/173 /dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde kye gsang gsum sogs nyams len gyi/ sbyor drug nyams len kun thugs la tshang / /dus 'khor ba chen po mus pa rje/ /pha sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud/ /bu bdag dang bdag la ltos bcas rnams/ /tshe 'di la bsam don kun 'grub cing / /dus phyi ma bde ba can bgrod mdzod/ /rje sprul pa'i skyes chen spyan snga bas/ /dus stag lo chu stod zla ba la/ /chos dus 'khor smin grol stsal ba'i tshe/ /nyams gang shar glu dbyangs 'di 'then no/ /spyan 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i lta stangs kyis/ /steng nyi zla sgra gcan g.yo med bcings/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung brtan pa yis/ /'og bshang gci khu ba'i rtsa gsum bsdams/ /phyag khu tshur brla steng btsugs te bsrang / /gnad 'dis kyang ro rkyang dbu mar 'jug /phyal g.yo 'gul med pas bar gyi rlung / /rgyun chags su 'dzin pa sgom gyi gzhi/ /steng nyes pa 'og tu bcings pas sel/ /'og 'gags pa steng rlung byung ste bsal/ /gnad 'di dag skyil krung rnam gsum ste/ /rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo'i snying po yin/ /thugs ma bcos yid byed bral ba'i ngang / /yengs med du mnyam par bzhag pa las/ /las rlung gi rgyu ba dhu tīr thim/ /gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dbyings su yal/ /stong gzugs kyi lha mo bzhin mdzes ma/ /rnam 'gyur gyis 'dzum phreng ci yang ngom/ /'bral med du 'khyud pa'i rtse dga' las/ /bde chen gyi 'dod pa 'jo bar gyur/ /cir snang kun 'gag med bde stong ngang / /nges don gyi dus 'khor rang gi sems/ /rang zhal mthong med kyi tshul du mthong / /bslu med kyis nyams rtags bzang po 'di/ /'di phyi dang bar do thams cad du/ /rgyun chad med rang rgyud la 'byor par/
